Senior Full Stack Ruby on Rails Engineer (Frontend)

We're looking for a mid-to-senior Full-Stack Ruby on Rails Developer with a strong frontend focus to lead the charge on our Rails-based applications in the adult entertainment space. Our flagship product, Mr. Skin, has been online for over 25 years and continues to attract millions of visitors each month, and now we're making it faster, sleeker, and easier to maintain!

While new applications and services may use Node.js, Rails remains at the core of our platform. You should be comfortable working in Rails views (ERB, Haml) and parts of the legacy frontend (Backbone, jQuery, Bootstrap 3), while also introducing modern design systems and reusable components to improve performance and maintainability.

You'll be the go-to person for all things frontend in a product team of 4 developers, QA, and DevOps, working closely with the lead engineer and backend developers across Rails and Node.js services. If you're a proactive self-starter, you'll fit right in! This role is perfect for someone who values autonomy and enjoys shaping how our frontend evolves.

  • Refactor and migrate legacy code to TypeScript, React, Web Components, and Bootstrap 5.
  • Build new frontends for Node.js applications, ensuring consistency with our design systems and modern stack.
  • Create and maintain design systems that keep our components, typography, and styling looking sharp and consistent.
  • Improve Core Web Vitals, implement SEO changes, and run A/B tests to boost conversions.
  • Write unit tests with Jest and maintain high-quality code standards.
  • Collaborate closely with the team to deliver features that impact millions of visitors.

  • Strong frontend development skills with solid JavaScript and TypeScript experience.
  • Comfort working with Ruby on Rails and Node.js backend tasks.
  • Comfortable refactoring and improving legacy code. You're not afraid to dive in and clean things up.
  • Experience working with a design system approach.
  • UX mindset with an eye for design. You know how to make things look beautiful and work great.
  • Curious about analytics and data-driven design decisions.
  • Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes is a plus.
Tech Stack & Tools
  • Ruby on Rails

  • JavaScript

  • Bootstrap
  • VideoJS

Why Work With Us?
  • Work from anywhere as part of a remote-first international team.
  • Own the frontend in a small, collaborative team where your decisions directly shape the product.
  • Build and improve high-traffic platforms that have influenced the adult entertainment industry for over two decades.
  • Enjoy a culture of autonomy where your impact is visible from day one and growth opportunities are everywhere.

Acesse afya.com.br para conhecer mais sobre a nossa história e todas as soluções que oferecemos.

Afya é uma companhia de capital aberto desde 2019, com ações negociadas na bolsa de valores Nasdaq, nos Estados Unidos. Em 2023 disponibilizamos nossas ações também na bolsa brasileira, a B3. Saiba mais sobre esse assunto em ir.afya.com.br .

Nosso propósito é transformar a saúde em conjunto com quem tem a medicina como vocação. Para isso, contamos com um time de 10 mil pessoas curiosas, parceiras, comprometidas, adaptáveis e realizadoras. Gente de todos os cantos do Brasil, com diferentes sotaques, mas falando a mesma língua, unida pelo mesmo propósito. Se você se identifica com o jeito Afya de ser, vem com a gente transformar a saúde com educação e tecnologia . #VemSerAfya

title: Mutirão de empregos em Marília terá vagas para supermercado e serviços
description:
Mutirão de empregos em Marília terá vagas para supermercado e serviços Processo de contratação tem apoio da prefeitura com atendimento no Teatro Municipal, com entrevistas por ordem de chegada.

Mutirão de empregos em Marília terá vagas para supermercado e serviços.

Marília — Uma nova etapa de mutirão de empregos em Marília vai promover na próxima terça-feira, dia 14, um dia de contratações para as empresas Confiança Supermercados e Login Serviços com atendimento no Teatro Municipal.

O processo prevê, inclusive, entrevistas no local por ordem de chegada com abertura do atendimento às 9h e encerramento às 16h.

A oferta da estrutura integra programa de apoio da Prefeitura de Marília para as contratações. Aliás, será a sétima ação de contratações com suporte de espaços públicos.

Porém, não há informações detalhadas sobre as funções, salários e nem número de profissionais que as empresas vão contratar.

O Confiança Supermercados estará recrutando candidatos para todas as funções em suas duas unidades de Marília. Já a Login Serviços oferecerá vagas operacionais em áreas como expedição, produção, portaria, serviços de limpeza, entre outras funções da indústria e prestação de serviços.

Para participar, os interessados devem comparecer ao local com documentos pessoais e currículo, e ter disponibilidade de horário para aguardar e participar das entrevistas.

O secretário do Trabalho, Turismo e Desenvolvimento Econômico, Vitor Gazola, destacou os mutirões como estratégia de desenvolvimento.

“Os mutirões de emprego buscam aproximar as empresas do cidadão e concentrar esforços rumo à geração de emprego e renda. É uma iniciativa que traz resultados concretos para a população. É dessa conexão que nasce o desenvolvimento.”

title: Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil
description:
Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil

Share

We are delighted to announce that Bruna Carvalho has been appointed to Managing Director, Brazil, effective immediately.

Bruna joined Clarksons in September 2024 and is now firmly establishing Clarksons’ Deep-Sea Tanker desk in Rio de Janeiro. South America is becoming an increasingly significant market. Providing an on-the-ground presence in the region ensures Clarksons is well placed to support clients as the market and opportunity grows. Bruna’s 18-year career at Petrobras has afforded her a wealth of experience and leadership expertise.

“Bruna has demonstrated impact since day one – she fits in well to the Clarksons culture, has contributed tremendously to the relaunch of Clarksons in Rio and has established herself as a strong leader. We are confident that her vision and drive will be instrumental in shaping the next exciting phase of our growth and success in the region, and that she will contribute hugely to the global management team at Clarksons.”

Andi CaseCEO

“My first 9 months at Clarksons have been fantastic. First and foremost, my focus is establishing the tankers presence - nurturing new and existing client relationships and demonstrating the insight and expertise that is available when partnering with Clarksons. I’ve had the opportunity to represent the business at global events, to connect and contribute towards internal networks within Clarksons, and together with the team have shaped our brand-new office space - I feel empowered and very proud to be part of this dynamic and forward-thinking business.”

The Brazil office currently has 20 employees across four service lines – Deep Sea Tankers, Specialised Products, Dry Cargo and Offshore & Renewables. A special mention must go to Jens Behrendt who has laid very strong foundations in the running of the office to date and will continue to head up the region’s Offshore and Renewables desk. Last month, the team hosted a joint celebration with more than 500 clients at the top of Sugar Loaf Mountain, to mark the new office opening in the centre of Rio, providing the space to scale and more than double headcount over the next couple of years.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Platforms
description:
3 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Why should you join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

What’s the opportunity?

We are looking for a thoughtful, experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate will join a team that takes full responsibility implementing new features, improving performance, and building robust solutions for our payments products and more!

What will I be doing?

  • Contributing in all phases of the development lifecycle
  • Designing, developing and delivering high-volume, low-latency applications for mission-critical systems
  • Writing well designed, testable, efficient code
  • Ensuring designs are in compliance with specifications
  • Supporting continuous improvement by investigating alternatives and technologies and presenting these for architectural review


What skills do I need?

  • 5+ years of software development experience using Java SE
  • Knowledge of microservices architecture
  • Experience working with: Spring, Maven, Java
  • Knowledge of other language ecosystems, for example, Node/Express, GoLang/Gin
  • Experience using in production with relational databases (MySQL, AuroraDB, Postgresql, Oracle) and optimizing queries for performance
  • Experience using in production with non-relational databases (redis, DynamoDB, mongoDB)
  • Experience with Cloud Providers such as AWS (preferred) or GCP
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines is a plus
  • Experience with Platform tools such as K8s, Docker, is a plus
  • Written and spoken English
  • Ability to translate user requirements into technical solutions
  • Ability to quickly master new technologies
  • Ability to work independently
  • Be a team player


What do we offer?

Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!*
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded
  • Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription
  • Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes
  • Social budget: you'll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!
  • dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!
  • For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required


What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our webpage, Linkedin, Instagram, and Youtube for more about dLocal!Seniority level

title: Supervisor de Centro de Distribuição - Aparecida de Goiânia GO
description:
Job description

Supervisor de Centro de Distribuição será responsável por coordenar todas as operações logísticas, desde o recebimento até a expedição de produtos, garantindo eficiência, qualidade e cumprimento de prazos. Atuará na gestão de equipe, controle de estoque, organização do armazém e monitoramento de indicadores de desempenho. Deverá promover melhorias contínuas nos processos e assegurar o cumprimento das normas de segurança. Buscamos um profissional com experiência em logística, liderança e visão estratégica

Local de trabalho: Presencial em Aparecida de Goiânia GO

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Nós da Tintas Kokar temos duas razões principais para escolher essa região como nosso local de atuação:

Primeira, temos conhecimento e experiência na região, acreditamos que podemos aproveitar essa oportunidade para oferecer produtos de qualidade e nos destacar como uma marca líder na região.

Segunda, ao contrário de outros fabricantes que direcionam seus esforços para regiões mais populosas ou próximas aos grandes centros comerciais, nós escolhemos focar na Região Centro-Oeste e Norte, especialmente no Tocantins. Reconhecemos que há desafios logísticos nessa região devido à distância dos principais centros, mas vemos isso como uma oportunidade para superar essas barreiras e fornecer soluções viáveis e rentáveis para o varejo local e o setor da construção civil.

Estamos em busca de profissionais dedicados e motivados para se juntarem a nós nessa jornada. Se você está interessado em fazer parte de uma empresa que busca expandir seu mercado, oferecendo produtos de qualidade, convidamos você a se candidatar e fazer parte da equipe Kokar. Juntos, podemos alcançar o sucesso e impulsionar o desenvolvimento econômico da região.

Main responsibilities

O que nós esperamos de um Supervisor de Centro de Distribuição na Tintas Kokar para atuar especificamente em Aparecida de Goiânia GO:

  1. Supervisionar todas as operações do Centro de Distribuição, incluindo recebimento, armazenagem, separação, conferência e expedição de produtos , garantindo a acuracidade dos estoques e a integridade dos materiais.
  2. Planejar e coordenar as atividades logísticas do CD, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos de entrega e a eficiência no atendimento às demandas de clientes internos e externos.
  3. Garantir a organização física e funcional do armazém , otimizando o uso de espaço, layout, fluxo de materiais e processos, conforme normas de segurança e boas práticas operacionais.
  4. Acompanhar e validar as condições de armazenagem dos produtos , assegurando conformidade com padrões de qualidade, identificação correta e acondicionamento adequado.
  5. Liderar e desenvolver a equipe operacional , distribuindo tarefas, acompanhando o desempenho, controlando jornada, aplicando treinamentos e promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e produtivo.
  6. Monitorar indicadores operacionais (KPIs) de performance do CD, como acuracidade de estoque, produtividade, OTIF (on time in full) e eficiência logística.
  7. Gerenciar inventários periódicos e rotativos , garantindo a confiabilidade dos saldos e a rastreabilidade dos produtos no sistema WMS.
  8. Controlar o fluxo de entrada e saída de mercadorias , apoiando as áreas de Suprimentos, Produção, Logística e Comercial, assegurando comunicação e integração entre setores.
  9. Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e planos de melhoria contínua , identificando gargalos, propondo soluções e otimizando custos operacionais.
  10. Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança do trabalho, ambientais e de transporte , zelando pela integridade física da equipe e conservação das instalações.

Principais atribuições

  • Gestão integral das operações do Centro de Distribuição;
  • Planejamento logístico e cumprimento de prazos de entrega;
  • Organização, segurança e eficiência do espaço físico;
  • Controle de qualidade e acuracidade de estoque;
  • Liderança e desenvolvimento da equipe operacional;
  • Análise de indicadores e relatórios de desempenho;
  • Implantação de melhorias contínuas em processos logísticos.
Requirements and skills

Requisitos básicos:

  • Curso técnico completo em Logística, Cadeia de Suprimentos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão de estoque (WMS) e controle de inventário;
  • Boa capacidade de liderança, organização e tomada de decisão.

Diferenciais desejáveis:

  • Experiência comprovada (mínimo de 2 anos) em gestão de operações logísticas ou centro de distribuição;
  • Ensino superior em andamento ou concluído em Logística, Administração ou áreas afins;
  • Conhecimento intermediário de Excel;
  • Certificações ou cursos complementares em gestão de estoques, transporte ou segurança operacional.
Additional information
  • Horário: 07:30h às 17:30h de segunda à sexta feira;
  • Local de trabalho: Aparecida de Goiânia – GO.

Os benefícios oferecidos hoje são:

  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale-alimentação / Vale-refeição;
  • Descontos expressivos na aquisição de produtos Kokar;
O foco e compromisso com os nossos talentos é o que nos move:
  • Em parceria com a Pulses, a plataforma de Clima e engajamento da Gupy, vamos implementar uma cultura de feedback contínuo, permitindo que os colaboradores expressem suas opiniões e sugestões de maneira frequente, o que contribui para o engajamento e fortalecimento do relacionamento entre a empresa e seus funcionários.
  • Com base nos resultados das pesquisas da Pulses, a Kokar vai implementar ações específicas e direcionadas para melhorar o clima organizacional e aumentar o engajamento dos colaboradores, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e produtivo.
Investir na formação das nossas equipes esta no DNA da Kokar:
  • Estamos constantemente realizando treinamentos internos e externos, de diferentes áreas e que atendem a todos os níveis da organização.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Acompanhar os processos da loja.

  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de planilhas de vendas, metas, escalas e tarefas diárias para a equipe.

  • Responsável pelo recebimento do carro forte.
  • Realizar as erratas mensais com mudança de preço.
  • Conferir os valores dispensados pelos caixas em dinheiro (sangrias).
  • Complementar os caixas com trocos (moedas ou cédulas), conforme suas necessidades.
  • Assumir a gerência na ausência do Gerente de Loja.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Cursando graduação em farmácia.
  • Conhecimento em informática.
  • Experiência em liderar equipes e organizar processos administrativos.
  • Experiência com vendas e atendimento ao cliente.
Benefícios
  • Vale-refeição (de acordo com a convenção coletiva).
  • Vale-transporte.
  • Plano de Saúde por elegibilidade por localidade e cargo.
  • Plano Odontológico por adesão.
  • Seguro de vida e Assistência Funeral.
  • Plataforma de terapia online.
  • Programa de Gestantes.
  • Convênios Educacionais com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e dependentes.
  • Universidade Corporativa Pague Menos com cursos e treinamentos - Up Farma.
  • Desconto Ouro nas Farmácias Pague Menos.
  • Convênio Farmácia, com desconto em folha de pagamento - Epharma.

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

VEM SER GIGANTE, VEM TRABALHAR NA REDE DE FARMÁCIAS QUE É DO TAMANHO DO BRASIL

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma, saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e, por meio da valorização humana, da superação de resultados, do foco no cliente, da sustentabilidade, da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore. Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde. Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente.

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

title: Logistiek Medewerker
description:
Bij Jan Zandbergen zijn we op zoek naar logistiek medewerkers die ons team komen versterken.

OVER JAN ZANDBERGEN

Jan Zandbergen is leverancier van ingrediënten, halffabricaten, producten en concepten op het gebied van vlees, gevogelte en vleesvervangers. Met zo’n 150 medewerkers werken we vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Veenendaal. Hier bevinden we ons in het hart van Dutch Food Valley: de regio waar bedrijven en onderzoeksinstituten in de food een krachtig netwerk vormen en samen nieuwe kansen benutten. Naast ons hoofdkantoor en twee productielocaties bezit de Jan Zandbergen Group een inkoopkantoor in Curitiba, Brazilië, waar een vlotte en nauwkeurige toestroom van goederen gegarandeerd kan worden. Met ons tweede verkoopkantoor in London ervaren onze klanten een efficiënte aansluiting en brengt dit zekerheid voor in de toekomst.

OVER DE ROL

Bij Jan Zandbergen hebben we een van de modernste magazijnen in de voedingsmiddelenindustrie. Het logistieke team van 30 collega’s is strak op elkaar ingespeeld, zodat elke order zo efficiënt mogelijk wordt samengesteld en op weg kan naar onze klanten in heel Europa. Bij ons is de klant koning en staat kwaliteit altijd voorop. Zo is geen dag, maar ook geen order hetzelfde.

WAT GA JE DOEN?
  • Je verwerkt orders en maakt deze verzendklaar.
  • Je pakt producten van verschillende pallets, weegt ze nauwkeurig in en laadt en lost goederen efficiënt.
  • Je controleert verpakking, label en houdbaarheidsdatum, zodat producten zo vers mogelijk bij de klant aankomen.
  • Als je (eenmaal) een certificaat voor de hef- en/of reachtruck hebt, verzamel je pallets vanuit diverse locaties in ons magazijn.
  • Je begint tussen 5:00 en 6:00 uur in de ochtend tot 15:00 of je begint om 15:00 tot 00:00. 1x in de 4 weken sta je op zaterdag paraat. Uiteraard krijg je hier een mooie vergoeding voor, bovenop je basissalaris.
  • Wil jij je verder ontwikkelen? Bij ons krijg je alle ruimte om dit te doen!

WIE ZOEKEN WIJ?

  • Het is mooi meegenomen als je ervaring hebt in een magazijn.
  • Je bent nooit uitgeleerd.
  • Je bent geen koukleum, en je vindt het niet erg om met dierlijke producten te werken.
  • Je kan goed schakelen tussen verschillende taken.
  • Je vindt het leuk om mee te denken over alles in je vak, bijvoorbeeld het optimaliseren van de processen; je ondersteunt de dagelijkse leiding maar al te graag met je kennis en kunde.
  • Je bent secuur omdat je orders precies inweegt en (kwaliteits-)controles uitvoert.
  • Je bent flexibel inzetbaar.
WAT BIEDEN WE JOU?
  • Een bruto basissalaris tussen de €2.500,- en de €3.000,- per maand (op basis van kennis, kunde, leeftijd en opleiding), basistoeslag, koude toeslag, onregelmatigheidstoeslag, overurentoeslag, vakantiegeld, eindejaarsgratificatie, kortom: een mooi inkomen.
  • 24 vakantiedagen per jaar en 8% vakantiegeld;
  • Elke dag gratis lunch met fruit, salade, soepen en verse broodjes;
  • 2% eindejaarsuitkering;
  • De mogelijkheid om elke werkdag te sporten in de gym in ons eigen Food Innovation Center.
  • Elke vrijdagmiddag is er een gezellige borrel en verder hebben we toffe afdelings- en bedrijfsuitjes! Ook hebben we regelmatig andere leuke activiteiten zoals "heel Zandbergen bakt", een bingo, een pub quiz of zaalvoetbal.
  • 6 keer per jaar de mogelijkheid om tegen een scherp tarief vlees(-vervangers) te kunnen aanschaffen.
  • Een vaste stabiele baan waar je jezelf kunt ontwikkelen en kunt verder groeien in taken, verantwoordelijkheden en salaris.
  • Een financieel gezonde werkgever die kiest voor de lange termijn.
  • Onze slogan is niet voor niets "Innovation That Matters". Dus verwacht veel initiatieven die we "gewoon gaan doen", Jan Zandbergen Group staat nooit stil, dus je carrière ook niet. We bieden in- en externe trainingen en opleidingen.
SOLLICITEER

Wil je ons team komen versterken als logistiek medewerker? Dan horen we graag van je!

title: General Manager
description:
Company Description

Fairmont Hotels is a globally renowned luxury brand, celebrated for creating unforgettable memories for our guests. With more than 30,000 colleagues worldwide, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional service, embracing innovation, and fostering a culture of excellence.

Hotel Overview

Perched on the world-famous Copacabana Beach, the Fairmont Copacabana is one of Rio de Janeiro’s most prestigious luxury addresses and a symbol of city’s glamorous lifestyle. With 375 rooms and suites, many offering panoramic views of the ocean and Sugar Loaf Mountain, the hotel blends timeless elegance with the vibrant energy of Rio.

As a leading destination for both leisure and business travelers, the hotel boasts extensive meeting and event spaces, hosting everything from high-profile international conferences to glamorous weddings and social gatherings. With its enviable beachfront location, modern design infused with local culture, and a legacy of warm Brazilian hospitality, the Fairmont Copacabana embodies the art de vivre of Fairmont while standing as an icon of Rio de Janeiro’s luxury hotel scene.

Job Description

As the General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana , you will embody the essence of luxury hospitality. Your dynamic and hands‑on approach is fueled by a deep passion for developing people and fostering an entrepreneurial spirit. A true brand and guest ambassador, you will challenge conventions, consistently seek solutions, and infuse innovation into every facet of the hotel experience and every function of the business.

Your seasoned leadership style will blend diplomacy with relationship‑building prowess, cultivating strong connections with both internal and external stakeholders, including Owners and the Community. Your ability to engage with ownership and strategize revenue enhancements will be coupled with an innate talent for envisioning the hotel's long‑term trajectory.

A refined sense of finance and business acumen will be at the core of your decision‑making, grounded in an unwavering commitment to delivering a world‑class product and service. By seamlessly weaving local heritage and culture into our offerings, you will not only create an authentic guest experience but also drive excellence across all dimensions of our operations.

In your role as a catalyst for exceptional service, you will uphold the highest standards, infusing every interaction with the kind of genuine care that leaves an indelible mark on our guests. Nurturing an environment of continuous growth and skill development, you will inspire our colleagues to consistently exceed expectations, turning moments into memories for every visitor.

As a visionary leader, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our strategic direction. Your involvement in goal setting and objective communication will propel business growth and solidify the hotel’s reputation as a distinguished luxury destination. Your ability to foster positive relationships with ownership will ensure a harmonious partnership that aligns with our overarching strategy while enhancing the hotel's performance and prestige.

Your leadership will be synonymous with setting industry benchmarks and redefining luxury hospitality. Your commitment to excellence, coupled with your innovative approach, will leave an enduring mark on our iconic brand and create a legacy of unparalleled guest memories.

Reporting Structure

The General Manager of Fairmont Copacabana will report to the Cluster Delegate Manager for Rio de Janeiro Luxury Hotels , as part of the unique cluster structure that unites Accor’s flagship luxury properties in the city.

Qualifications Key Behaviours and Responsibilities:
  1. 1. Act with an open mindset:

    Embrace innovative ideas, adapt to change, and encourage a culture of innovation and continuous learning.

    Demonstrate explicit knowledge and awareness of company standards as an integral role model.

    Build quality relationships with the management team.

    Create an environment that encourages innovation, challenges traditional thinking, and fosters a "speak‑up" culture.

  2. 2. Create positive impact working with others:

    Foster an inclusive and collaborative work environment, empowering colleagues to contribute their best and building strong relationships based on trust and respect.

    Create a collaborative and inclusive environment where all colleagues are encouraged to provide input.

    Actively listen to team members' ideas, concerns, and feedback and incorporate their input into decision‑making processes.

    Recognize and appreciate the contributions and well‑being of colleagues.

  3. 3. Strive for guest/client satisfaction:

    Exhibits a deep understanding of the luxury hospitality landscape and guest expectations, ensuring that the guest experience consistently exceeds industry standards.

    Maintain product and service quality standards by conducting ongoing evaluations.

    Handle VIP Guests and understand international protocols for government officials and royalty.

    Monitor guest/client feedback, address concerns promptly, and implement improvements to optimize satisfaction.

  4. 4. Consistently deliver excellence:

    Demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of ownership group's investment objectives and formulates strategic business plans that align with those objectives; ensuring preservation and maximization of the hotel’s assets.

    Set high performance standards, lead by example, and drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality across all the hotel.

    Exhibits expertise in sales, marketing, and revenue management, driving the hotel's performance in the luxury hospitality market.

    Maximize financial performance, control costs, and execute marketing and operational activities that produce results meeting or exceeding the hotel's business plan.

    Recognize and reward outstanding performance and celebrate achievements within the organization.

  5. 5. Enable team success:

    Support the professional growth and development of colleagues through coaching, mentoring, and providing opportunities for learning.

    Encourage individuals to take on challenging assignments and stretch their capabilities.

    Provide regular feedback and guidance, recognizing achievements and offering constructive suggestions for improvement.

    Create a safe and empowering environment where individuals feel comfortable taking risks, expressing their ideas, and learning from failures.

    As applicable, brings experience in working with labor unions, maintaining constructive relationships and ensuring harmonious teamwork.

  6. 6. Create clarity:

    Articulates a clear and comprehensive vision for the hotel, aligning goals and objectives with ownership group's investment strategy.

    Effectively communicates organizational vision, goals, and expectations, fostering a shared sense of purpose and direction among team members.

    Demonstrates adeptness in overseeing renovation projects, maintaining transparency and open communication throughout the process.

    Addresses ambiguity and navigates complex situations with transparency, fostering an environment of clear direction and effective problem‑solving.

  7. 7. Inspire for top performance:

    Lead with passion and integrity, motivate and inspire others to achieve their best.

    Market plans and ideas successfully, reducing key and complex ideas and messages to clear, memorable, and compelling statements.

    Embodies an entrepreneurial spirit, inspiring innovative thinking and fostering a culture that encourages taking calculated risks.

    Recognizes and rewards outstanding performance, cultivating an atmosphere of achievement and recognition.

    Promotes continuous development and growth, offering resources and guidance to nurture professional skills and talents.

    Champions a "speak‑up" culture, creating an environment where diverse opinions are valued, and individual contributions are celebrated.

    Convince others, negotiate, debate, and find win‑win solutions.

Additional Information

  • Strong educational background with professional qualifications and a continuous learning mindset.
  • Fluent in English and in Portuguese or Spanish (mandatory)
  • Experience in working in Latin America, preferably in Brazil (mandatory)
  • Proven track record of building a strong service, and quality culture
  • Strong people skills and a track record of fostering positive, inclusive, high‑performing cultures.
  • Experience in managing owner relations.
  • Demonstrated leadership, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strategic thinker with excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Displays a strong entrepreneurial spirit
  • Bottom‑line oriented with a focus on quality guest service and team‑building.

  • Excellent sense of prioritization and time management.

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

O projeto Revitalizar é uma iniciativa voltada para promover a inclusão social de indivíduos sentenciados à pena de Prestação de Serviços à Comunidade (PSC) e beneficiários de acordos de não persecução penal na comarca de Belo Horizonte (MG). O projeto é realizado em parceria com sociedade civil, poder público Municipal e poder Judiciário.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O Gerente é responsável pela gestão integral do Projeto Revitalizar, executado em parceria com a Vara de Execuções Penais – VEP/TJMG e Prefeitura de Belo Horizonte. O Gerente realiza o acompanhamento da rotina de cumprimento da pena dos beneficiários, através do manejamento e articulação com serviços parceiros, a fim de executar os objetivos pactuados com o Tribunal de Justiça de Minas Gerais.

RESPONSÁIVOS:
  • Atuar na gestão do ciclo do projeto relacionado ao Termo de Parceria entre AVSI e o Tribunal de Justiça de Minas Gerais;
  • Organizar o trabalho da equipe e direcionar as tarefas para o alcance dos resultados esperados do projeto;
  • Atuar no acompanhamento social dos beneficiários das penas de prestação de serviços à comunidade, assim como acolhimento do público do projeto e realização de atendimentos remotos e eventualmente presenciais; e articulação de casos com a rede de atendimento;
  • Planejar e subsidiar a administração na execução dos processos administrativos (compras, contabilidade, financeiro, seleção de RH, controle orçamentário), conforme regras e procedimentos da AVSI Brasil, garantindo o cumprimento das regras do financiador e uma atenta e eficiente gestão administrativa dos recursos;
  • Contribuir na construção das estratégias de comunicação e visibilidade, incluindo a supervisão do envio das informações para o setor de comunicação, periodicamente;
  • Organizar os cursos de capacitação para beneficiários;
  • Supervisar estágio não obrigatório nas áreas do Serviço Social e/ou Psicologia;
  • Mediar relações entre beneficiários e referências de acompanhamento da Prefeitura de Belo Horizonte;
  • Elaborar documentação para Conselho Municipal de Assistência Social;
  • Elaborar Prestação de Contas quantitativa e qualitativa para o Tribunal de Justiça de Minas Gerais;
  • Realizar visitas e Reuniões Institucionais com parceiros para alinhamentos de fluxos;
  • Garantir um ambiente de trabalho conforme a política de compliance e o Código de Ética e Conduta da AVSI Brasil;
  • Participar dos momentos de trabalho propostos pela Gerente Geral MG;
  • Representar juntamente a Gerência Geral de Minas Gerais a AVSI Brasil nos ambientes institucionais inerentes a iniciativa;
  • Contribuir para ampliação das parcerias sugerindo e construindo outras iniciativas correlatas;
  • Promover a sustentabilidade da iniciativa através do engajamento e agregação de novos parceiros, realizando inclusive elaboração de novas propostas técnicas e comerciais com este objetivo.

A Mackay Marine Brasil atualmente tem vagas em nossas localidade Santos para Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo com experiência, habilidades e qualificações abaixo. Mackay se originou e está sediada nos EUA, é necessário ter proficiência em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.

Resumo do Trabalho de Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo:

Sob supervisão limitada, os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo (MST) instalam, fazem manutenção e reparam equipamentos eletrônicos marítimos a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. Eles testam, ajustam e solucionam problemas de componentes, PCBs, subconjuntos e antenas, bem como carregam, atualizam e modificam o software. Os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo utilizam seus conhecimentos de teoria e circuitos eletrônicos para resolver uma variedade de problemas técnicos, bem como para fazer uso inteligente de esquemas complexos, projetos e manuais para realizar tarefas com precisão. Após a conclusão de cada trabalho, o técnico redigirá e enviará um relatório de serviço detalhado.

  • Rádios HF e VHF

Qualificações do Técnico em Marítima:

  • Mais de 3 anos como MST na indústria de transporte marítimo comercial.
  • Um diploma universitário em engenharia ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.
  • Proficiente em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.
  • Forte conhecimento de teoria e aplicação de eletrônica.
  • Licença de Operador de Rádio GMDSS preferencialmente.
  • Fisicamente apto. O ambiente de trabalho geralmente envolve carregar 20 quilos, subir escadas/mastros, trabalhar em espaços confinados e exposição ao clima.

Somos a empresa pioneira no desenvolvimento de inovações que contribuem com a transição energética, a ISA ENERGIA BRASIL é formada por mais de 1.600 colaboradores e atua em 18 Estados do Brasil, operando uma rede de transmissão por onde trafegam cerca de 30% de toda a energia elétrica transmitida no País e aproximadamente 95% no Estado de São Paulo.

Seu acionista controlador é a empresa colombiana ISA, que detém 35,82% do capital total.

Se você se interessou e acredita que é a pessoa certa, venha juntar a sua energia com a nossa!

  • Acompanhar e apoiar na elaboração de especificações técnicas, análises de propostas, avaliação de novas tecnologias, planejamento e execução de projetos, soluções de problemas e diagnósticos, implantação de Hardware, Softwares e sistemas relacionados ao departamento, assim como no acompanhamento de seus desenvolvimentos, destinados ou relacionados com a Supervisão e Controle do Sistema Elétrico de Potência

  • Acompanhar ensaios e testes de aceitação em campo (TAC) e fábrica (TAF) em arquiteturas de rede, sistemas e aplicações da norma IEC 61850, garantindo o funcionamento e a padronização

  • Desenvolver outras atividades inerentes ao cargo ou a critério de seu superior imediato, desde que habilitado e estejam de acordo com o seu conhecimento e experiência
  • Administrar e configurar os equipamentos e infraestrutura das redes LAN e WAN da rede operativa, bem como apoiar na configuração de equipamentos de segurança cibernética (firewall, IDS, IPS, etc) de forma a garantir o atendimento aos padrões e requisitos pré-estabelecidos
  • Contribuir na configuração, desenvolvimento, manutenção e implantação de sistemas e aplicações utilizadas pelo Departamento de Operação, assim como prestar suporte e treinamento interno aos usuários, administrar e fornecer segurança de acesso aos sistemas, através do uso de métodos e sistemas específicos para esse fim

  • Superior Completo em Engenharia da Computação, Engenharia Elétrica ou Engenharia de Automação e Controle
  • Conhecimentos Sólidos em Manutenção e configuração da base de dados do SCADA SAGE; Análise e diagnóstico (troubleshooting) de protocolos industriais, como: IEC 60870-5-101, IEC 60870-5-104, ICCP, DNP3; Manutenção e administração de Sistemas Operacionais Linux e Windows Server; Redes de computadores TCP/IP e protocolos de comunicação; Virtualização de servidores (VMARE vSphere, vCenter); Administração de Active Directory (AD); Administração de banco de dados e instruções SQL (PostgreSQL e SQL Server); Modelagem de requisitos técnicos funcionais com foco em desenvolvimento de software; Automação de tarefas administrativas via Ansible, PowerShell ou Bash e Monitoramento proativo com ferramentas como Zabbix, Grafana

title: Intensivist - Elisabeth TweeSteden ziekenhuis - 0.8 FTE - 6-12 maanden
description:
Vanaf 1 september 2025 heeft de zorgeenheid Intensive Care (IC) een prachtige baan voor je als intensivist. In deze functie draag je zorg voor de opvang, diagnostiek en behandeling van acuut vitaal bedreigde patiënten op locatie ETZ Elisabeth en locatie ETZ TweeSteden. Dat doe je zowel op de IC-afdeling als daarbuiten. Je werkt samen met een team van intensivisten, arts‑assistenten, physician assistants, practitioners IC, verpleegkundig specialisten en IC‑verpleegkundigen. Daarnaast lever je een actieve bijdrage aan wetenschappelijk onderzoek en onderwijs, binnen én buiten de intensive care.

Hier ga je werken

Het ETZ is een level 1 traumacentrum en behoort tot de grootste centra op het gebied van neurochirurgie, longchirurgie en GE‑chirurgie en kent bovenregionale functies voor onder andere de interventieradiologie, HIV‑zorg, dialyse en hoofd‑hals oncologie.

De zorgeenheid Intensive Care bestaat uit één IC en één HC‑locatie. Locatie ETZ Elisabeth telt drie IC‑units met in totaal 24 bedden. Locatie ETZ TweeSteden is ingericht als HC‑opvang met twee bedden. De IC heeft op beide locaties een groot aantal neventaken, zoals reanimatie/RRT en participatie in het traumateam. Daarnaast zijn de intensivisten, door deelname aan staffuncties, ziekenhuisbrede commissies en neventaken, zichtbaar aanwezig in de organisatie. De staf bestaat uit internist‑intensivisten, anesthesioloog‑intensivisten, chirurg‑intensivisten en een neuroloog‑intensivist. Er zijn twintig vaste stafleden en drie chef de cliniques. Op beide locaties zijn dag en nacht arts‑assistenten aanwezig, waaronder vijf physician assistants, die in ploegendienst werken. De groep bestaat deels uit arts‑assistenten interne geneeskunde, chirurgie en spoedeisende hulp.

De IC van het ETZ is een ambitieuze, hoogwaardige afdeling in ontwikkeling, met als primaire focus de kwaliteit van herstel en overleving van patiënten. Wij zien de IC daarin als een afdeling‑overstijgende functie. We hebben de ambitie en mogelijkheden om de komende jaren diverse structurele veranderingen door te voeren om hier verder invulling aan te geven. Wetenschappelijk onderzoek en kwaliteitsbeleid zijn hier onderdeel van.

Je arbeidsvoorwaarden
  • Je krijgt een arbeidsovereenkomst voor 0,6-0,8 fte, voor een periode van zes tot twaalf maanden. Er is zicht op verlenging, tot de verhuizing naar de nieuwbouw medio 2027.
  • Je werkt op een innovatieve Intensive Care, waar we complexe patiëntenzorg combineren met een open sfeer en korte lijnen. De werkomgeving is dynamisch en we behandelen een hoog volume aan patiënten uit de hele regio.
  • Je ontvangt een vergoeding volgens de Arbeidsvoorwaarden Medisch Specialisten (AMS), aangevuld met de geldende toeslagen.
Zo buitengewoon ben jij
  • Je bent een intensivist met sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel binnen als buiten de Intensive Care.
  • Je bent een teamspeler.
  • Je werkhouding is patiëntgericht, integer en kwaliteitsgericht.
  • Je bent een doorzetter met een positieve instelling.
  • Je bent flexibel en beschikt over aanpassingsvermogen in een steeds veranderende omgeving.

In het ETZ geloven we dat buitengewoon van binnen zit. In wie je bent, hoe je denkt, en wat je elke dag presteert. Voel jij die gedrevenheid ook van binnen? Dan passen we goed bij elkaar!

Meer informatie

De sollicitatiegesprekken zijn op maandag 16 juni 2025, ’s avonds. Wil je meer informatie over deze functie? Mevrouw dr. A. Kotsopoulos, intensivist, helpt je graag verder. Bel naar .

title: intensivist - ETZ - 0.8 FTE - 12-24 maanden
description:
De zorgeenheid Intensive Care (IC) heeft per direct een prachtige baan voor je als intensivist (gewenste startdatum vóór 1 januari 2026). In deze functie draag je zorg voor de opvang, diagnostiek en behandeling van acuut vitaal bedreigde patiënten op locatie ETZ Elisabeth en locatie ETZ TweeSteden. Dat doe je zowel op de IC als daarbuiten. Je werkt samen met een team van intensivisten, arts-assistenten, physician assistants, IC-verpleegkundigen, practitioners IC en verpleegkundig specialisten. Daarnaast lever je een actieve bijdrage aan wetenschappelijk onderzoek en onderwijs, binnen én buiten de intensive care.

Hier ga je werken

Het ETZ is een level 1 traumacentrum en behoort tot de grootste centra op het gebied van neurochirurgie, longchirurgie en GE-chirurgie en kent bovenregionale functies voor onder andere de interventieradiologie, HIV-zorg, dialyse en hoofd-hals oncologie. De zorgeenheid Intensive Care bestaat uit één IC en één HC-locatie. Locatie ETZ Elisabeth telt drie units met in totaal 24 bedden. Locatie ETZ TweeSteden is ingericht als High Care-afdeling met twee bedden. De IC heeft op beide locaties een groot aantal neventaken, zoals reanimatie en Rapid Response Team (RRT) en participatie in het traumateam. Daarnaast zijn de intensivisten, door deelname aan staffuncties, ziekenhuisbrede commissies en neventaken, zichtbaar aanwezig in de organisatie. De staf bestaat uit internist-intensivisten, anesthesioloog-intensivisten, chirurg-intensivisten en een neuroloog-intensivist. Er zijn twintig vaste stafleden en drie chefs de clinique. Er zijn dag en nacht arts-assistenten (ANIOS en AIOS) aanwezig, waaronder vijf physician assistants, die in ploegendienst werken. De groep bestaat deels uit arts-assistenten interne geneeskunde, chirurgie en spoedeisende hulp. De IC van het ETZ is een ambitieuze, hoogwaardige afdeling in ontwikkeling, met als primaire focus de kwaliteit van herstel en overleving van patiënten. Wij zien de IC daarin als een afdeling-overstijgende rol (IC zonder muren). We hebben de ambitie en mogelijkheden om de komende jaren diverse structurele veranderingen door te voeren om hier verder invulling aan te geven. Wetenschappelijk onderzoek en kwaliteitsbeleid zijn hier onderdeel van.

Je arbeidsvoorwaarden
  • Je krijgt een arbeidsovereenkomst voor 0,6-0,8 FTE, voor een periode van twaalf maanden. Er is zicht op verlenging, tot de verhuizing naar de nieuwbouw medio 2027.
  • Je werkt op een innovatieve Intensive Care, waar we complexe patiëntenzorg combineren met een open sfeer en korte lijnen. De werkomgeving is dynamisch en we behandelen een hoog volume aan patiënten uit de hele regio.
  • Je ontvangt een vergoeding volgens de Arbeidsvoorwaarden Medisch Specialisten (AMS), aangevuld met de geldende toeslagen.
Zo buitengewoon ben jij
  • Je bent een geregistreerd intensivist (met BIG-registratie).
  • Je werkt actief samen met collega-intensivisten, verpleegkundigen, arts-assistenten, physician assistants, verpleegkundig specialisten en andere disciplines. Je stemt af, deelt kennis en draagt bij aan een sterk team.
  • Je legt duidelijk uit wat er speelt, zowel aan collega’s binnen en buiten de IC als aan patiënten en familie. Je bespreekt situaties helder en respectvol.
  • Je houdt overzicht over complexe patiëntenzorg en neemt beslissingen als de situatie daar om vraagt. Je kijkt verder dan alleen de IC en denkt mee over het herstel van de patiënt in het hele ziekenhuis.
  • Je houdt het hoofd koel in een dynamische omgeving. Je past je gemakkelijk aan bij wisselende situaties, zoals spoedopnames, complexe behandelingen of veranderingen in het ziekenhuis en de zorg.
  • Je signaleert kansen voor verbetering in zorg, onderzoek of onderwijs en neemt initiatief om hieraan bij te dragen. Je durft ideeën te delen en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.

In het ETZ geloven we dat buitengewoon van binnen zit. In wie je bent, hoe je denkt, en wat je elke dag presteert. Voel jij die gedrevenheid ook van binnen? Dan passen we goed bij elkaar!

Meer informatie

De sollicitatiegesprekken vinden plaats op donderdag 9 oktober 2025 in de avond. Wil je meer informatie over deze functie? Mevrouw dr. A. Kotsopoulos, intensivist, helpt je graag verder. Bel naar .

title: Intensivist - St Jansdal - 0.6 FTE - Jaarcontract met uitzicht op contract voor onbepaalde tijd
description:
intensive care (IC) van het St Jansdal ziekenhuis zijn wij per 1 januari 2026 op zoek naar een enthousiaste en betrokken intensivist. Deze vacature ontstaat door het aanstaande pensioen van één van onze collega’s. Wij zoeken een nieuwe collega die onze multidisciplinaire en collegiale groep komt versterken.

‘Met liefde en compassie de best passende zorg verlenen’ is de missie van het St Jansdal. Er wordt veel waarde gehecht aan laagdrempelige collegiale consultatie en korte lijnen. Samenwerking en loyaliteit kenmerken ons team, waarbij we persoonlijke en betrokken zorg voor onze patiënten centraal stellen.

We hebben een moderne IC met 10 volledig uitgeruste bedden, waarvan momenteel 8 operationeel. De huidige groep bestaat uit 8 intensivisten (5,2 fte), met een diverse achtergrond: vijf anesthesioloog-intensivisten, een chirurg-intensivist, een internist-intensivist en een longarts-intensivist.

Als intensivist verzorg je de dagelijkse werkzaamheden op onze IC. Je bent medisch verantwoordelijk voor de patiëntenzorg, verricht consulten in het ziekenhuis en participeert indien nodig in begeleid spoedtransport. Dagelijks is er een multidisciplinair overleg met wekelijks een pre‑operatieve bespreking die plaatsvindt op de IC. Daarnaast lever je een actieve bijdrage aan de vakgroep overleggen, beleidsontwikkeling en kwaliteitsverbetering. Je werkt zonder voorwacht in een dienstrooster met afwisselend 24‑uurssiensten en dagdiensten en bent samen met je collega’s verantwoordelijk voor een continue en kwalitatief hoogwaardige zorg. Er werken geen ANIOS of PA’s op onze IC, wel wordt er door de vakgroep actief bijgedragen aan de opleiding voor IC‑verpleegkundigen en ziekenhuisartsen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een jaarcontract voor 0,6 – 0,7 fte per week met de intentie, bij ongewijzigde organisatorische omstandigheden, deze om te zetten naar een contract voor onbepaalde tijd.
  • Een flexibel rooster met goede werk‑privé balans.
  • AMS is van toepassing

Wat vragen wij van jou?

Je zorgt voor een enthousiaste inbreng en bent een gezellige én professionele collega binnen de vakgroep.

  • Binnen de GIC geregistreerd als intensivist.
  • Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
  • Een BIG‑registratie en een inschrijving in het medisch specialistenregister van de RGS

Fellows die de opleiding binnenkort afronden en die voor aanvang van het dienstverband aan de voorwaarden voor GIC‑certificatie voldoen, worden eveneens uitgenodigd te reageren.

Ben je enthousiast?

Solliciteer dan via de sollicitatiebutton op Intensivist (0,6‑0,7fte) | Werken bij St Jansdal . Je kunt jouw sollicitatiebrief richten aan Natascha Diender, zorgmanager. Wil je liever eerst meer informatie over deze functie of wil je een dag meelopen, dan kun je contact opnemen met Kim Selles via het secretariaat van de IC op .

We ontvangen jouw motivatie en CV graag uiterlijk 2 oktober. De sollicitatiegesprekken staan gepland voor dinsdag 7 oktober einde middag – begin van de avond.

Het aanvragen van een VOG (verklaring omtrent gedrag) is onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure. Het navragen van recente referenties kan deel uitmaken van de procedure.

title: Research Fellow-3
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Research Fellow-3 role at Inside Higher Ed .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.
Core Competencies
  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.
Minimum Requirements
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$45,000-$55,000

description:
Join to apply for the Director of Product Strategy ID33849 role at AgileEngine

We are looking for a Director of Product Strategy in Buenos Aires.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we would love to meet you.

Overview

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Responsibilities
  • Client engagement & Pre-sales
  • Act as a trusted advisor in the pre-sales process, confidently engaging with potential clients to understand their vision, challenges, and goals.
  • Provide strategic product consulting, helping clients refine their product direction and align their vision with actionable roadmaps.
  • Lead and facilitate discovery sessions, ensuring a structured approach to defining business problems and opportunities.
  • Influence decision-making by articulating a clear product strategy and validating business value.
  • Proposal development & Consultancy
  • Work closely with internal teams to shape compelling proposals that align with the client’s business needs.
  • Provide strategic recommendations on product direction, market positioning, and user experience.
  • Define and estimate design efforts, contributing to proposal timelines and approaches.
  • Advocate for user-centered design, ensuring that proposals include practical, impactful design solutions.
  • Design leadership & Execution
  • Facilitate prototyping efforts, especially in the early stages of engagement, driving/creating napkin/high-level prototypes/concepts when needed.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align design with business strategy and technical feasibility.
  • Guide design decisions that enhance user experience while considering business and technological constraints.
  • Build the Center of Excellence (CoE) for Product Management.
  • Establish best practices for product management and strategic design within the company.
  • Grow the team of product owners, upskill team on product thinking, user research methodologies, and market validation techniques.
  • Develop frameworks and guidelines that help teams deliver high-quality product strategies across projects.
  • Advocate for a product-driven culture, ensuring teams maintain a balance between business needs, user needs, and technical execution.
  • Agility & Adaptability
  • Switch between different projects, industries, and challenges, adapting quickly to new client needs.
  • Excel in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities and ambiguous situations.
  • Take initiative in problem-solving, stakeholder management, and cross-team collaboration.
  • Communication & Influence
  • Communicate complex ideas clearly and persuasively, ensuring alignment across stakeholders.
  • Foster strong relationships with clients, internal teams, and leadership, acting as a bridge between business and design.
  • Confidently present, justify, and defend design and product decisions to both internal and external audiences.
Must Haves
  • Executive/Managerial experience: Conduct meetings with executive stakeholders (C-level, VPs, Directors, etc.), creating and driving presentations that showcase strategic thinking with a clear business impact.
  • Experience: 3+ years in Executive roles such as Director/Head/VP of Product Strategy, and/or 5+ years in Manager roles in Product Management and UX Design, or Product Strategy and UX Design roles.
  • Expertise in Product Strategy: Ability to define, refine, and validate product concepts with clients.
  • Strong UX Background: Hands-on experience in wireframing, prototyping, and user research.
  • Consultative Mindset: Experience working with clients, facilitating workshops, and shaping product visions.
  • Business Acumen: Understanding of market trends, competitive analysis, and product-market fit.
  • Excellent Communication: Comfortable leading client discussions, presenting ideas, and influencing stakeholders.
  • English: Upper-Intermediate level.
The Benefits of Joining Us
  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, with options to work from home or in the office.

title: Solutions Architect - Mobility Integrations
description:
Company Overview

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

Team Overview

Our technical team is the engine that powers our most innovative partnerships. We are the bridge between 99's platform and the outside world, designing and implementing the integrations that make ambitious ideas a reality. As a Solutions Architect, you will be the lead technical expert for Brazil, architecting API integrations with public and private entities and building automations that streamline our business processes. This role is crucial for our expansion into MaaS and beyond.

Role Responsibilities
  • Leading the technical discovery and design for integrations with external partners, primarily focusing on REST/SOAP APIs.

title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
description:
Overview

We have opened several senior/staff Security Operations Engineer (SOC) positions, creating a new team reporting to the CISO. We are looking for a range of experience in these positions. At the high end, we seek deep experience defending highly contested critical assets and high-value cyber targets against advanced persistent threats and state-level actors. We have more junior roles for exceptional individuals with a proven personal interest and engagement in cyber attack and defence, and outstanding academic and career performance even if experience is limited. Our goal is to build an entirely new level of assurance and observable rigour into the open source supply chain, expanding security across the Ubuntu estate and related ecosystems.

The Security Operations (SecOps) team is responsible for the design, implementation and evolution of Canonical security practices, techniques, tools, systems and policies. The team is the primary owner of strategy and practices that determine how Canonical secures its data, internal infrastructure and build processes. They design and implement technical security controls that ensure threats are automatically identified, contained and remediated. The team will also contribute ideas and requirements for Canonical product security, improving the resilience and robustness of all Ubuntu customers and users subject to cyber attack. The SecOps mission extends to the wider open source ecosystem, sharing knowledge through public presentations and threat intelligence with the community or representing Canonical in sector-specific governance bodies.

What you will do in this role:

  • Implement and evolve Canonical's Security Operation Center
  • Analyse and improve Canonical's security architecture
  • Evaluate, select and implement new security tools and practices
  • Identify, contain and guide the remediation of security threats and cyber attacks
  • Grow the presence and thought leadership of Canonical SecOps practice
  • Contribute to open source threat intelligence initiatives
  • Drive threat modelling, table top exercises and other SecOps practices across Engineering, IS and Canonical
  • Develop Canonical SecOps learning and development materials
  • Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations
  • Identify, implement and track SecOps KPIs
  • Plan and deliver SecOps work within Canonical's agile engineering framework
  • Collaborate with Security leadership to present information and influence change

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about an alternative path
  • Previous professional experience working or leading a Security Operations Center
  • Deep personal motivation to be at the forefront of technology security
  • Expertise in threat modelling and risk management frameworks
  • Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools
  • Experience contributing to, and consuming, threat intelligence feeds
  • Experience in security risk management frameworks such as NIST CSF and ISO27001

Optional things we value

  • Experience in a security operations team or a security operations centre (SOC)
  • Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability
  • Experience with state-actor and other advanced persistent threats

What we offer you

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, Canonical operates globally with a remote-first culture. We recruit on a global basis and maintain a high standard for people joining the company. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer and we foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. We will give every applicant fair consideration.

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

The Director is responsible for building trusted relationships with IHV partners, increasing Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelising the partnership and leading all business interactions from engineer to CxO. They will often run customer workshops focused on particular initiatives at that customer, attend sales events, give public presentations and lead executive engagements. Location: This role will be based remotely in EMEA or APAC regions.

As an IHV Alliance Sales Director you will:

  • Build strategic relationships with IHV partners at all levels
  • Grow their awareness of open source capabilities on Canonical Ubuntu
  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of the Linux and cloud software ecosystem
  • Negotiate contracts and commercial business terms
  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of large and complex organizations
  • Lead partnerships in APAC with companies like Lenovo, Huawei, Quanta, Fujitsu, Inspur, H3C, NEC, Asus etc.
  • Lead partnerships in EMEA with companies like Ericsson, Nokia, Bull, Siemens

  • Work closely with marketing, sales engineering and product management

  • Lead executive interlocks between IHV and Canonical leadership

Valued skills and experience

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. title: Head of Brand - Brasil
description:
Job Description

Location: São Paulo, Brasil

Type of contract: Full time

About Luzia

Luzia is LATAM’s fastest-growing consumer AI company, backed by world-class investors including Khosla Ventures, A*, Monashees, Prosus and Sequoia. Our mission is to redefine what conversational AI can do by leveraging cutting-edge large language models (LLMs) and advanced alignment techniques to create intuitive, human-like digital assistants.

Just two years after launch, Luzia is already woven into the daily lives of millions of Brazilians. We’re now deepening our roots here at home, bringing even more local flavor and warmth to everything we build. Join us and help shape Luzia’s voice and product for Brazil from day one.

The Role

As our Head of Brand in Brazil, you’ll build on Luzia’s existing brand foundation and bring it to life locally, adding the cultural nuance and emotional depth that resonates with Brazilian users. You’ll craft a distinctive, human brand presence that feels both consistent with our global identity and uniquely relevant to the local market. You’ll lead the charge in shaping how millions of people experience and connect with Luzia, working cross-functionally to build a brand that drives love, loyalty, and organic growth — positioning Luzia as the most trusted and beloved AI assistant in one of our most important markets.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and define Luzia’s brand in Brazil— identity, and voice to reflect the cultural context, emotional tone, and everyday realities of our Brazilian audience.

  • Create emotional connections with users— craft narratives, campaigns, and experiences that go beyond utility and build lasting emotional bonds with millions of users.

  • Champion brand consistency— ensure a unified voice and visual identity across all touchpoints: product, marketing, tech, and talent.

  • Manage Public Relations and storytelling efforts— partner with Brazilian agencies and internal teams to build earned local media strategies and tell stories that resonate with both mainstream and underserved communities.

  • Collaborate across teams— work hand-in-hand with product, growth, comms, and design to bring brand ideas to life and make sure everyone internally is aligned around a clear brand mission.

  • Translate insight into impact —lead research efforts on market positioning, user sentiment, and competitive dynamics in Brazil, acting as the closest voice to our users and ensuring their needs, culture, and perspective shape brand decisions at every level.

  • Use content and influencers as strategic tools— partner with local creators, ambassadors, and users to grow organic reach and relevance.

  • Drive organic brand growth — focus on strategies that scale awareness and engagement through word-of-mouth, content, SEO, and product-led storytelling — not just paid media.

  • Manage budgets and agency partners— oversee brand-related investments, including agency collaborations ensuring high return and aligned execution.

What We’re Looking For

  • A strategic brand builder who’s done this before in Brazil— ideally in a high-growth consumer tech company or strong brand-led startup.

  • Deep experience in brand, mobile, and PR— you know what it takes to launch and scale brand presence in the Brazilian market.

  • A strategic operator— able to zoom out and set long-term direction, while also rolling up your sleeves to execute or manage projects day-to-day.

  • Stay deeply connected to our audience— read comments and reviews, engage directly with users, and immerse in the behaviors, trends, and desires of Brazilian young adults to continuously adapt our messaging and brand voice.

  • Obsessed with the user— you’re constantly engaging with users and deeply in tune with Gen Z and Millennials, our core audience. You draw insight from their behaviors, language, and culture to craft brand experiences and messaging that genuinely resonate.

  • A storyteller at heart— with a gift for creating narratives that spark curiosity, trust, and emotion.

  • Fluent in visual and emotional branding— with strong creative sensibility and the ability to direct top-tier brand work.

  • Collaborative to the core— able to inspire teams, work across functions, and align stakeholders behind the brand vision.

  • Analytically sharp and resource-savvy— focused on high-impact, measurable initiatives and able to prioritize what moves the needle.

  • Tuned-in to Gen Z & Millennials— you intuitively speak their language, tap their cultural cues, and craft experiences that land with Brazil’s digital-native generations.

  • AI-savvy experimenter— eager to explore, question, and ship breakthrough AI features that put cutting-edge tech directly in users’ hands.

  • Fluency in English is required; Spanish is a plus.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working at a tech startup or fast-scaling mobile app in Brazil.

  • Track record of working closely with product and growth teams to align brand and user experience.

  • Ability to balance instinct and data — you know when to trust the numbers and when to lead with bold intuition.

Why Join Luzia?

At Luzia, you’ll help shape one of the most exciting consumer AI products in the world. We move fast, stay humble, and keep users at the center of everything we do. If you\'re passionate about AI, thrive in dynamic environments, and want your work to impact millions of people, we’d love to meet you.

Our Culture & Values

We’re builders at heart — driven by data, experimentation, and velocity. Our team lives by a “ship, learn, iterate” mentality, constantly pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. At Luzia, autonomy meets accountability in an environment where ideas win and learning never stops.

Your Impact

In this role, you won’t just be building a product — you’ll be helping define a category. The work you do will shape how millions of people interact with AI every day, and help chart Luzia’s course in one of our most important markets.

description:
Petrobras abre concurso com 6.412 vagas para nível técnico; confira

As inscrições começam às 10h desta quinta-feira (28/12) e vão até às 18h de 31 de janeiro

Redação com Correio Braziliense

A Petrobras publicou, nesta terça-feira (26/12), edital de concurso com 6.412 vagas, sendo 916 imediatas e 5.496 para formação de cadastro de reserva, para diversos cargos de nível técnico. As vagas são para cidades do Sudeste, Sul e Pernambuco. As inscrições começam às 10h desta quinta-feira (28/12) e vão até às 18h de 31 de janeiro. A remuneração inicial mínima é de R$ 5.878,82. Para se inscrever é necessário ter nível médio técnico.

O edital, publicado no Diário Oficial da União, será executado pelo Centro Brasileiro de Pesquisa em Avaliação e Seleção e de Promoção de Eventos (Cebraspe). As provas estão marcadas para 24 de março nas cidades vinculadas a cada um dos polos de trabalho correspondente. A taxa de inscrição custa R$ 62,79 e deverá ser paga até 21 de fevereiro. A isenção da taxa pode ser solicitada até 31 de janeiro.

VAGAS

Locais das vagas

As vagas são para Betim (MG), Cubatão (SP), Duque de Caxias (RJ), Itaboraí (RJ), Macaé (RJ), Mauá (SP), Paulínia (SP), Rio de Janeiro, Santos (SP), São José dos Campos (SP), Vitória, Araucária (PR), Canoas (RS), Ipojuca (PE) ou demais cidades na região Sudeste, Sul e Pernambuco que a Petrobras atue ou venha a ter atuação.
