Senior Database Consultant, Professional Services

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Senior Database Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Senior Database Consultant you will be proficient in working with customers to migrate their database environments to AWS, architecting complex, scalable, and secure database solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS.

As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key Job Responsibilities
  • Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS database solutions tailored to customer needs
  • Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
  • Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
  • Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
  • Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work‑life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud architecture and implementation
  • 5+ years of experience on at least one commercial relational database (Oracle, SQL, Server, IBM, DB2) or open source database (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB)
  • Knowledge of non‑relational database (MongoDB, CouchDB, Redis)
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, related field, or equivalent experience
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English in technical and business settings
Preferred Qualifications
  • 5+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale implementation experience
  • Experience with automation and scripting (e.g., Terraform, Python)
  • Expertise in performance optimization and cost management for cloud environments
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast‑paced environment
  • AWS Professional level certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional)
  • Knowledge of the primary AWS services (EC2, ELB, RDS, Route53, S3)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit for more information. O Grupo Multilaser foi fundado em 1987. Desde lá, seguimos crescendo, ampliando mercado e construindo parcerias duradouras junto aos nossos colaboradores, consumidores, clientes e investidores.

Temos 4 atributos importantes que nos definem: somos democráticos, humanos, antenados e descontraídos. Um dos nossos principais pilares é facilitar a vida das pessoas através da tecnologia. Em nossa Cultura, temos 3 pilares que nos orientam e direcionam: Gerar valor ao cliente, Fazer o certo do jeito certo e Sinceridade com Respeito.

Atuamos em mais de 15 categorias, temos 3 fábricas no Brasil e um laboratório na China, além dos escritórios em São Paulo e Belo Horizonte. São mais de 5 mil itens em portfólio, presentes em mais de 40 mil pontos de venda e em mais de 30 marketplaces parceiros.

Descrição da vaga

Prazer, somos a Suzano! Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado: a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria‑prima renovável em bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas. Cultivamos a vida na folha do caderno que alfabetiza as crianças, na fralda que protege os bebês, no copo de café que não prejudica o meio ambiente, em papéis absorventes e na comodidade do uso de uma embalagem sustentável.

PLURAL – Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, por isso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Aqui você pode descobrir novos desafios, novos horizontes, novos objetivos e até mais sobre si mesmo!

Dados

  • Inscrições até: 23/11/2025
O que você vai fazer?
  • Acompanhar no pátio de madeiras a realização das atividades operacionais de Logística Florestal;
  • Monitorar o cumprimento do padrão operacional das atividades de Logística Florestal;
  • Participar de reuniões diversas (Programação, Segurança, Comitês, Avaliação de provedores, Certificações, micro planejamento, Diálogos operacionais e Auditorias);
  • Contribuir para redução de custo e cumprimento das metas de produção;
  • Auxiliar a Interface e relacionamento com áreas afins e partes interessadas, especialmente nas áreas de influência das operações de Logística Florestal;
  • Monitorar e corrigir desvios de indicador de desempenho (Qualidade, Meio ambiente, Segurança, Utilização e Produtividade) da operação;
  • Apoiar na implantação e acompanhamentos de projetos relacionados ao desenvolvimento operacional;
  • Registrar não conformidades identificadas no processo e elaborar planos de ação para os devidos ajustes;
  • Apoiar no controle de qualidade e avaliação das atividades realizadas pela operação;
  • Acompanhar o descarte correto dos resíduos florestais;
  • Contribuir na realização de levantamento de informações de campo;
  • Levantar às demandas pertinentes a operação e compartilhar com demais áreas afins;
  • Executar as atividades conforme responsabilidades definidas nos procedimentos e instruções de trabalho da qualidade, meio ambiente e segurança.
Requisitos e qualificações Quem nos inspira?
  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
  • Com iniciativa;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.
O que a Suzano espera de você?
  • Ensino Técnico Completo;
  • CNH categoria "B" e/ou acima;
  • Experiência com Pacote Office, especialmente Excel (relatórios e indicadores);

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em revezamento de turnos;
  • Experiencia na área de Logística Florestal (Pátio de Madeiras);
  • Disponibilidade para residir em Ribas do Rio Pardo – MS.
Informações adicionais
  • Cuidados da sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida;
  • VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional;
  • Sabemos que a renda fixa é importante, mas, além disso, oferecemos uma renda extra por meio do nosso Programa de Remuneração Variável (Anual);
  • Para você se preparar para o futuro temos a Previdência privada;
  • Praticamos o home office em áreas corporativas, a flexibilidade de horários, além do dress code casual;
  • Para gerar e compartilhar valor disponibilizamos cursos e treinamentos E‑learning em nossa plataforma digital, o UniverSuzano;
  • Na Suzano, só é bom para nós se for bom para o mundo! Por isso, durante o ano realizamos muitas ações legais e você poderá se tornar um voluntário do nosso programa Voluntariar;
  • Também contamos com um Clube de Descontos, com diversos parceiros, para você aproveitar!
Para a família

Como empresa cidadã, entendemos a importância da chegada de uma criança. Por isso, oferecemos extensão da licença paternidade para 20 dias e maternidade para 180 dias. O benefício também vale para papais e mamães que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homoafetivos.

Para as mamães retornarem tranquilas ao trabalho, oferecemos um auxílio creche bem bacana.

Pensando em oferecer sempre as melhores condições para nosso time e suas famílias, disponibilizamos um auxílio mensal em dinheiro que se aplica ao pai ou mãe que tiver sob sua guarda filho ou filha com alguma necessidade especial.

Aqui seus filhos e filhos não ficam de fora, oferecemos um vale brinquedo e um kit material escolar recheado! E, se no final do ano os filhos mandarem bem na escola, reconheceremos o seu esforço por meio do nosso programa Estudar é Crescer, com um prêmio em dinheiro que poderão usar como preferir.

Suzano Faz Bem

O Faz Bem tem um cuidado especial para você, colaborador(a) e sua família, confira abaixo:

  • Tele Faz Bem: Atendimento gratuito e confidencial ao colaborador(a) Suzano e seus(as) dependentes(as) nas seguintes frentes: Apoio psicológico e de assistência social, orientação jurídica, financeira, de atividade física e nutricional;
  • Plataforma de saúde mental – A Wellz, oferece sessões de terapia online subsidiadas pela Suzano de forma confidencial, além de várias oportunidades de autocuidado como jornadas, diário de humor, terapia em grupo, entre outros;
  • Plataforma de saúde física – A Wellhub é uma plataforma completa de bem-estar com acesso a academias, aplicativos e aulas on‑line com liberdade de escolha de atividades.
  • Programa de gestantes – O programa “Bebê Saudável” realiza o acompanhamento gestacional através de contato telefônico e abordagens, além do recebimento de um kit personalizado.
Empresa Brasileira de Referência

Somos uma empresa multinacional brasileira, referência global no desenvolvimento de soluções sustentáveis e inovadoras, de origem renovável, por meio do plantio de árvores de eucalipto. E elas estão no centro do nosso propósito, que é o de “renovar a vida a partir da árvore”. É assim que nós plantamos um futuro mais sustentável para o planeta e para as pessoas.

Temos 100 anos de vida, e hoje, somos a maior fabricante de celulose do mundo e uma das maiores produtoras de papéis da América Latina. Nossos produtos atendem mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do planeta e nós exportamos para mais de 100 países. Quanto às unidades, entre administrativas e operacionais, estamos presentes também internacionalmente na Argentina, Áustria, Canadá, China, Estados Unidos, Finlândia, Israel e Suíça.

E, tudo isso só é possível por causa das pessoas da Suzano: somos a soma de cerca de 20 mil colaboradores(as) próprios(as) e mais de 20 mil terceiros e terceiras, além de 300 colaboradores(as) em nossos escritórios internacionais. Trabalhamos para ser uma empresa competitiva e protagonista na transformação da nossa cadeia de valor e da sociedade.

Somos gente que cuida de gente.Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã.

Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Vem conferir!

  • Acompanhar os processos da loja;
  • Realizar um acompanhamento diário junto aos caixas e ou operador de loja, observando o preenchimento de formulários, agilizando o atendimento ao cliente e auxiliando a equipe nas horas de maior fluxo na farmácia;

  • Responsável pela parte financeira da farmácia tais como: troca, devolução, cancelados e cartões;

  • Responsável pelo recebimento do carro forte;
  • Realizar as erratas mensais com mudança de preço;

  • Complementar os caixas com trocos (moedas ou cédulas), conforme suas necessidades;

  • Cursando graduação em farmácia;
  • Conhecimento em informática;
  • Experiência em liderar equipes e organizar processos administrativos;

  • Vale-refeição (de acordo com a convenção coletiva);

  • Desconto Ouro nas Farmácias Pague Menos;
  • Convênio Farmácia, com desconto em folha de pagamento - Epharma;

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore . Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . title: SUPERVISOR DE TRÁFEGO (Lote 05 Paraná)
description:
Job description

Segurança, inovação e desenvolvimento. Construa essa história com a gente.

O Lote 05 do Paraná, é um dos mais importantes projetos de infraestrutura rodoviária do Estado do Paraná. Vamos transformar 440 km de rodovias com investimentos de R$ 4,6 bilhões, trazendo mais segurança, fluidez e desenvolvimento para toda a região.

O período de concessão, contempla a duplicação de 239 km de rodovia, a implantação de 20 km de vias marginais, a correção de traçado de 2 km de via, além da implantação do contorno de Peabiru. É prevista, também, a implantação de 51 interseções em desnível, 1 viaduto, 17 retornos e rotatórias em nível, 5 passarelas, 6 obras de arte especiais, além de 12 km de ciclovias.

E nada disso acontece sem pessoas. Por isso, estamos em busca de profissionais que queiram crescer junto com esse desafio e fazer parte dessa transformação.

Por que trabalhar com a gente?

  • Fazer parte de um projeto de impacto regional que transforma vidas e gera desenvolvimento.
  • Oportunidades de crescimento em um ambiente dinâmico e inovador.
  • Participar de uma empresa que valoriza segurança, tecnologia e sustentabilidade.
  • Contribuir diretamente para um futuro com mobilidade eficiente.

Se você busca novos desafios, este é o lugar para você.

Se identificou? Se candidate em nossas novas vagas e compartilhe! ️

Main responsibilities

Responsável por supervisionar e monitorar as operações de tráfego nas rodovias sob concessão. Suas atribuições incluem a supervisão das equipes de atendimento, a análise de dados de fluxo e acidentes, e a implementação de estratégias para otimizar a segurança e a fluidez do tráfego.

Além disso, o supervisor deve garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança e regulamentações vigentes, promovendo a comunicação entre as áreas operacionais e as autoridades competentes.

Responsável pelo correto andamento dos serviços desempenhados pelas equipes de tráfego. Dar suporte e planejar as operações de maior complexidade, comparecendo pessoalmente durante os serviços de maior gravidade. Informar a gerência de operações sobre eventos de maior gravidade e de repercussão. Apoiar o CCO no planejamento das ações, apoios a sinalizações em obras e campanhas na rodovia.

Conduzir o andamento das atividades de balança móvel, dando apoio necessário às equipes de pesagem, acompanhar relatórios de pesagem e o correto andamento dos serviços.

Dar suporte à ouvidoria nas questões relacionadas a elogios, reclamações e sugestões de usuários, atuando junto às suas equipes para solução de problemas. Participar de reuniões de trabalho em órgãos como ARTESP, DER, DERSA ou qualquer outro tipo de organismo de apoio à atividade de operação. Estudar os pontos críticos de acidentes, acompanhar e apresentar soluções que contribuam para a redução dos índices.

Executar outras tarefas correlatas, a critério do superior imediato.

Requirements and skills
  • Ensino superior completo em Logística, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável Pós-Graduação em Gestão de Pessoas ou áreas correlatas ao Tráfego e Rodovias, diferencial;
  • Desejável experiência mínima de 5 anos na área de Tráfego/Rodovias e Gestão de Equipes;
  • Desejável experiência em tráfego, transportes e veículos de grande porte;
  • Conhecimento em tráfego no ramo de concessões de rodovias;

title: Pessoa Técnica de Gasoduto II
description:
A ENGIE Serviços de Operação e Manutenção é responsável por operar e manter os gasodutos da TAG empresa adquirida pelo grupo em 2020. Com a aquisição da TAG a ENGIE é detentora da mais extensa malha de transporte de gás natural do país com 4.500 km que atravessam 10 estados e 191 municípios.

Missão do Cargo

Cumprir integralmente os indicadores contratuais estabelecidos entre Cliente e Empresa alinhando-os às políticas e diretrizes da organização. Assegurar a conformidade dos processos de Operação e Manutenção Inspeção de Equipamentos e Faixa de Duto garantindo que as atividades estejam em estrita concordância com as expectativas de ambas as partes. Manter um padrão de excelência que reflita os valores e compromissos compartilhados por todos os envolvidos.

Principais Atividade
  • Atender às ordens de serviço de mecânica elétrica instrumentação inspeção ou automação solicitadas pelo Planejamento ou Clientes para realizar intervenções preventivas preditivas e corretivas em estruturas fixas e móveis (Ecomp). Executar tarefas no campo com ferramentas adequadas expertise técnica e materiais de alta qualidade incluindo substituições quando necessário. Garantir a operacionalidade contínua dos ativos prevenindo falhas e interrupções que possam comprometer a eficiência e confiabilidade do sistema.
  • Realizar análise técnica crítica de desvios nos processos identificando problemas na malha de controle e equipamentos com tendência ou falhas de média complexidade seja por meio da medição de vibração ruído dos equipamentos ou através de um marcador de temperatura. Utilizar instrumentos adequados para detectar e avaliar esses desvios categorizando as causas raiz das falhas nos equipamentos com o objetivo de documentar observações e resultados da análise técnica para a resolução das inconformidades.
  • Realizar abertura de Ordem de Serviço para investigar a causa raiz de desvios operacionais conduzindo uma análise aprofundada para reparar inconformidades identificadas e examinar minuciosamente o problema do equipamento e da malha de controle considerando parâmetros inferiores e superiores com objetivo de preservar a continuidade operacional e manter o custo operacional conforme o orçamento estabelecido.
  • Instalar e calibrar instrumentos de medição como transmissores de pressão temperatura fluxo cromatógrafos e computadores de vazão. Realizar ajustes finos e executar testes de desempenho para assegurar leituras precisas garantindo que todos os sistemas estejam operando dentro dos parâmetros especificados.
  • Elaborar memoriais descritivos detalhando especificações e procedimentos para serviços na faixa de dutos garantindo clareza e conformidade das atividades. Criar relatórios técnicos com conclusões e recomendações baseadas nos serviços realizados. Desenvolver croquis e soluções para tratar não conformidades detectadas em inspeções assegurando clareza nas atividades a serem executadas.
  • Inspecionar a faixa verificando aspectos geotécnicos como erosões e sistemas de drenagem e identificando ações inadequadas de proprietários concessionárias e outras partes interessadas. Avaliar a adequação da sinalização e a conservação das instalações de superfície como áreas das válvulas garantindo a integridade do gasoduto e a segurança da infraestrutura de transporte de gás. Registrar as inspeções no software utilizado gerando ordens de serviço para programar e executar as atividades necessárias corrigindo inconformidades e assegurando o acompanhamento eficiente das ações de manutenção preservando a integridade e eficácia do sistema de transporte de gás
  • Desenvolver estudos e realizar ações para abordar problemas associados à proteção catódica incluindo a avaliação e resolução do potencial de proteção catódica analisando questões identificadas seguida pela implementação de medidas corretivas para garantir a eficácia e integridade contínuas do sistema de proteção catódica.
  • Atuar e acompanhar serviços de inspeção de equipamentos e seus acessórios tubulação dispositivos de segurança avaliação de integridade e vida útil residual incluindo inspeção terrestre de faixas de dutos e instalações. Garantir a conformidade com os requisitos legais e normativos assegurando a segurança e a eficácia das operações.
  • Realizar o acompanhamento das inspeções de equipamentos e correlação na faixa de dutos assegurando a integridade e eficiência dos sistemas. Elaborar relatórios técnicos detalhados que documentem minuciosamente todas as atividades realizadas e suas conclusões. Identificar e relatar áreas suspeitas de atividades clandestinas contribuindo para a segurança e conformidade das operações. Operar veículos necessários para deslocamentos dentro das áreas de trabalho garantindo a mobilidade eficiente durante as inspeções. Além disso realizar Ensaios Não Destrutivos convencionais conforme necessário para avaliação e manutenção dos equipamentos e estruturas inspecionados.
  • Atuar de forma autônoma nos processos de Operação Manutenção Faixa de Dutos e Inspeção de Equipamentos buscando suporte do Técnico III em atividades mais complexas. Além disso apoiar e colaborar com as atividades do Técnico I conforme exigido.

title: Frentista - Linhares
description:
O frentista desempenha um papel vital em um posto de combustível, sendo frequentemente a primeira impressão que os clientes têm da qualidade do serviço. No Grupo Schueng, buscamos profissionais que sejam atenciosos, carismáticos, pacientes e possuam excelente comunicação. Aqui, atender o cliente não é apenas uma tarefa; é uma oportunidade para criar uma experiência memorável que exemplifique os mais altos padrões de excelência do Grupo Schueng.

Além de atender com simpatia e profissionalismo, o frentista deve também ser um vendedor habilidoso , capaz de identificar as necessidades dos clientes e oferecer soluções que agreguem valor. Essa habilidade vai além de uma simples transação; é sobre construir relacionamentos e criar confiança.

No Grupo Schueng, reconhecemos e recompensamos o esforço de nossos frentistas. Por isso, criamos um programa exclusivo de vendas que permite aos colaboradores participar dos lucros das vendas de produtos (exceto combustíveis), possibilitando alcançar níveis de comissão muito acima do mercado atual.

Para integrar nossa equipe, é desejável ter, no mínimo, o ensino médio completo e realizar cursos especializados, como NR20, atendimento ao cliente, NR07, NR09 e NR23. Esses treinamentos garantem a preparação técnica e a segurança necessárias para desempenhar a função com excelência.

A soma dessas qualidades e habilidades transforma o frentista do Grupo Schueng em um verdadeiro embaixador de nossa missão: proporcionar atendimento de qualidade, com eficiência e dedicação, sempre pensando no melhor para o cliente.

Trabalhar como frentista no Grupo Schueng vai muito além do abastecimento. Você será uma peça fundamental para garantir a satisfação dos clientes e a excelência dos serviços prestados. Suas principais atividades incluem:

  • Abastecer veículos: Realizar o abastecimento de forma segura e eficiente, garantindo a satisfação e confiança do cliente.
  • Atender clientes: Realizar o atendimento seguindo o padrão de excelência do Grupo Schueng, iniciando sempre com um caloroso: "Seja bem‑vindo ao Grupo Schueng". Demonstrar cordialidade, atenção e criar uma experiência agradável em cada interação.
  • Auxiliar no pagamento: Orientar os clientes sobre formas de pagamento e operar sistemas de recebimento com precisão.
  • Limpar e manter veículos: Realizar pequenos serviços de limpeza, como o para‑brisas, para proporcionar um diferencial no atendimento.
  • Verificar a qualidade do combustível: Garantir que o combustível esteja em conformidade com os padrões de qualidade do Grupo Schueng.
  • Calibrar pneus: Ajudar os clientes a manterem a segurança de seus veículos com o ajuste adequado da pressão dos pneus.
  • Trocar óleo: Oferecer serviços de troca de óleo com cuidado e profissionalismo, sempre respeitando as necessidades do cliente.
  • Limpar para‑brisas: Proporcionar maior visibilidade e segurança aos motoristas com um serviço simples, mas eficiente.
  • Testar a iluminação dos automóveis: Auxiliar na verificação de faróis, lanternas e outros sistemas de iluminação dos veículos.
  • Organizar e manter todas as dependências da unidade limpas: Garantir um ambiente sempre limpo, organizado e convidativo para os clientes e colaboradores.
  • Responsabilidade em cada abastecimento: Cada vez que você realiza um abastecimento, está assumindo um papel essencial na experiência do cliente. É fundamental garantir que o combustível correto (gasolina, diesel, etanol ou outros) seja utilizado com total atenção e que o valor recebido esteja exato, garantindo a precisão do seu turno no sistema de controle.
  • Zelar por equipamentos: Cuidar dos patrimônios da unidade é uma responsabilidade essencial que reflete seu compromisso com a excelência. Manter os equipamentos em bom estado, prevenindo danos e preservando sua funcionalidade, é uma atitude que garante a qualidade do serviço e a segurança de todos.

Essas atividades e muitas outras que podem não estar aqui listadas são realizadas com o suporte dos nossos padrões rigorosos de qualidade e segurança e o líder da unidade, que refletem o compromisso do Grupo Schueng em oferecer um serviço diferenciado e de excelência.

Qualificações desejáveis

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Curso de atendimento ao cliente.
  • Treinamentos NR20, NR07, NR09 e NR23.
  • Experiência em vendas e atendimento ao cliente.

Job description

Segurança, inovação e desenvolvimento. Construa essa história com a gente.

O Lote 05 do Paraná, é um dos mais importantes projetos de infraestrutura rodoviária do Estado do Paraná. Vamos transformar 440 km de rodovias com investimentos de R$ 4,6 bilhões, trazendo mais segurança, fluidez e desenvolvimento para toda a região.

O período de concessão, contempla a duplicação de 239 km de rodovia, a implantação de 20 km de vias marginais, a correção de traçado de 2 km de via, além da implantação do contorno de Peabiru. E nada disso acontece sem pessoas. Por isso, estamos em busca de profissionais que queiram crescer junto com esse desafio e fazer parte dessa transformação.

Se você busca novos desafios, este é o lugar para você.

Responsável pelo planejamento das atividades do pedágio, acompanhando o desempenho dos colaboradores responsáveis pela operação das praças de pedágio. Responsável pela arrecadação de pedágio (financeiro), responsável pelos funcionários (escala, ponto, uniforme, treinamentos e avaliação de desempenho), responsável pela contratação de funcionários (processo de seleção) e redução de custos.

Somos gente que cuida de gente. Cada um com características, histórias e qualidades únicas, mas todos unidos pelo mesmo propósito: viver plenamente. Temos orgulho da nossa história, por isso fazemos o nosso melhor hoje, sem deixar de olhar para o amanhã. Se você preza pela valorização humana, integridade, foco no cliente, superação de resultados, sustentabilidade, inovação em soluções em tudo o que faz, vem fazer parte do nosso time de gigantes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma, saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza! Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana, da superação de resultados, do foco no cliente, da sustentabilidade, da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil. Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore. Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde. Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos. Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente. Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

Reporting to the Director of Operations in Brazil, The Order Entry Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the order entry process ensuring accuracy and efficiency in processing customer orders.   • Administers employee time and attendance reporting.

  • Ensures all work assignments are performed in accordance with Company’s Policy and Compliance.

This position requires access to export‑controlled information or items (i.e. regulated technology or technical data per ITAR / EAR US regulations). Applicants must be eligible to apply for and obtain the appropriate export control license from the U.S. Departments of State or Commerce.

Não fazemos distinção de cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore . Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

About the Role

The Process Optimization Partner plays a key role in transforming the People Team’s operations through technology, automation, and intelligent systems. You’ll analyze workflows, identify inefficiencies, and design scalable solutions that enhance the employee and stakeholder experience. This role blends strategic problem‑solving with hands‑on implementation, leveraging AI tools, process automation, chatbot systems, and dynamic knowledge bases to optimize how the People Team operates.

Key Responsibilities
  • Evaluate, document, and improve People Team workflows across the employee lifecycle (recruiting, onboarding, development, engagement, and offboarding).
  • Identify automation opportunities using tools like Zapier, Workato, Power Automate, or internal HRIS systems.
  • Partner with HR stakeholders to reduce manual work, streamline approvals, and improve process accuracy.
  • Implement and monitor AI‑driven workflows that enhance response times and reduce operational bottlenecks.
  • Design and maintain AI‑powered chatbots to handle routine HR and general support inquiries, FAQs, and employee self‑service needs.
  • Continuously analyze chatbot performance to improve accuracy, tone, and efficiency using feedback loops and analytics.
  • Collaborate with IT and data teams to ensure proper integration between HR systems and conversational AI platforms.
  • Build and manage a centralized HR knowledge base that supports employees, managers, and the People Team.
  • Develop structured documentation practices to ensure consistency and ease of information retrieval.
  • Implement taxonomy and tagging systems that enable quick search and smart recommendations.
  • Define and track key metrics related to process efficiency, automation adoption, and employee experience.
  • Use data and feedback to prioritize initiatives and communicate impact to leadership.
  • Stay current on emerging HR technologies, AI trends, and automation best practices.
Qualifications
  • 3–5+ years of experience in HR operations, process improvement, or business automation.
  • Strong understanding of HR workflows, systems, and employee experience design.
  • Hands‑on experience with automation platforms (Zapier, Boomi, etc.) and/or AI assistants or chatbot builders (e.g. ChatGPT Enterprise, etc.)
  • Familiarity with HRIS platforms (HiBob, Workday, or similar).
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to translate strategy into execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a collaborative and analytical mindset.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Hubspot CRM.
  • Exposure to AI prompt engineering, knowledge management, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Passion for creating intuitive, efficient, and employee‑friendly systems.
Success in This Role Looks Like
  • The People Team operates with greater speed, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Employees and managers can easily find answers through AI chatbots and a robust knowledge base.
  • Manual, repetitive tasks are reduced or eliminated through automation.
  • Continuous improvement becomes a core capability of the People function.
Values:
  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start‑Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection.
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.
Advantages of joining Turing:
  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation

title: Enterprise Architecture Lead (Director)
description:
Description

We're looking for a strategic leader who sees the big picture and can translate complex requirements into a connected, forward-looking architectural vision.

You’ll be part of a dynamic environment where adaptability, proactive problem-solving and outcome-driven thinking are key. Your ability to build strong networks internally and externally will help shape a resilient and inclusive architecture that supports our evolving business needs.

You'll be responsible for overseeing the enterprise-wide technology strategy. This role focuses on aligning technology solutions with business objectives. You'll lead a team of dedicated Enterprise architects and specialists, ensuring adherence to architectural standards and best practices. You'll collaborate closely with Product and Platform leaders and architects, providing guidance on solution design and integration. You'll also develop and maintain the Architecture Repository as a central capability for Brambles globally.

Key Responsibilities May Include
  • Lead the Enterprise Architecture team, guiding them in setting technology policies, standards, and governance practices across the organization, ensuring compliance with lifecycle and asset management standards.
  • Develop and maintain the business, technical, application, information, process, and infrastructure views of the organization's architecture to ensure cohesive and efficient operations.
  • Ensure the technology strategy is aligned with the organization's business strategy and incorporates current technology and market trends to drive future growth.
  • Partner with key business and technology stakeholders to provide a clear architectural roadmap, ensuring integration between IT and business goals while meeting organizational expectations.
  • Communicate the enterprise architecture strategy and associated roadmaps to impacted stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment across departments.
  • Chair and manage the Technology Review Board (TRB) to drive strategic technology decisions, ensuring that technological advancements align with the organization's strategic objectives.
  • Oversee the development and communication of the enterprise architecture strategy, ensuring it supports both current needs and future business demands.
  • Continuously monitor and assess emerging technology trends, ensuring that the enterprise architecture evolves to meet both internal and external challenges and opportunities.
Experience
  • Enterprise Architecture Expertise: Proven expertise in Enterprise Architecture principles, frameworks, and methodologies. This includes experience in defining and enforcing architectural standards, best practices, and principles across complex organisations.
  • Technology Governance and Compliance: Experience in overseeing technology governance processes, policies, and practices. This involves ensuring compliance with technology-related policies, industry regulations, and best practices.
  • Solution Design and Integration: Demonstrated proficiency in solution design and integration, particularly in collaborating with Product and Platform teams to align technology solutions with business objectives. This includes experience in leading the design of integrated systems.
  • Team Leadership and Management: A track record of leading and managing teams of architects and specialists. This includes direct experience in providing guidance, mentorship, and direction to ensure adherence to architectural standards and best practices.
  • DR and Business Continuity Planning: Experience in developing and implementing IT Disaster Recovery (DR) plans, with a focus on the recovery of all business technology products and services. This also involves collaborating with cross‑functional teams to ensure effective DR execution.
  • Knowledge Management and Repository Development: Background in developing and maintaining enterprise‑wide knowledge repositories of technology and tools. This encompasses ensuring accessibility and relevance of knowledge resources for architectural decision‑making.
  • Data Architecture and Management: Proficiency in data architecture design and management, especially for business intelligence, analytics, and data warehousing. This includes experience in ensuring data integrity, availability, and security.
  • Technology Selection and Application: Experience in providing advisory support to teams on technology selection and application. This involves overseeing the avoidance of duplication in technology investments and solutions.
  • Regional Technology Oversight: Experience in providing oversight of regional technology needs and choices, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards. This includes facilitating communication and collaboration between central EA function and regional teams.
  • Policy Development and Compliance: Experience in managing enterprise processes, policies, and practices for the selection and advancement of technologies. This involves ensuring compliance with technology‑related policies and industry best practices.
  • Change Management and Transformation: Background in leading organizational change initiatives related to technology and process improvement. This includes fostering a culture of agility, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Skills
  • In‑depth understanding of Enterprise Architecture principles, frameworks, and methodologies.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate business goals into technology initiatives.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency in evaluating emerging technologies and industry trends.
Qualifications Essential
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Master’s degree is a plus.
Desirable
  • Relevant certifications in Enterprise Architecture or related domains (e.g., CoBIT, TOGAF) are highly desirable.
Remote Type

Hybrid Remote

Skills to succeed in the role

Adaptabilidade, Développement de talent, Direction inclusive, Engagement avec les parties concernées, Établissement des priorités, Feedback, Innovation, Intelligence émotionnelle, Learn From Mistakes, Littératie numérique, Mentorat, Motiver les équipes, Prise de décision fondée sur les données, Travail interfonctionnel

Guiados pela nossa estratégia “Reviver o Incrível”, focamos em um crescimento liderado por marcas com três grandes apostas: Peet’s, L’OR e Jacobs, além de um portfólio de 9 ícones locais, como Douwe Egberts, Kenco, Pilão, Old Town, Moccona, Super, Gevalia, Friele e Marcilla.

Em 2024, a JDE Peet’s gerou 8,8 bilhões de euros em vendas e contava com mais de 21 mil colaboradores no mundo todo.

No Brasil, somos uma das maiores empresas de café e temos atuação nacional através de nossas marcas Pilão, L’OR, Café do Ponto, Damasco, Café Maratá, Caboclo, Café Pelé, Café Puro, Chá Maratá e Chá Castelari.

Somos pessoas unidas pelas possibilidades de café e chá. Na JDE Peet's, nós nos desenvolvemos com a liberdade de buscar oportunidades e de provocar novas ideias para causar um impacto positivo no mundo do café e do chá. Nossa ambição é simples: despertar possibilidades de café e chá. Colocamos em prática nossas intenções, cumprindo o que foi acordado e sempre levando as coisas adiante. Oferecemos aos nossos associados uma série de programas de aprendizado e desenvolvimento para apoiar seu crescimento pessoal. Na JDE Peet's, acreditamos que é incrível o que acontece ao redor de uma xícara de café ou chá.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours.

This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours.

Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients.

Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B.

I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that - if you are a runner and marketeer - probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

You’ll be working on a newsletter and pling!

  • an email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors.

Whoop whoop!

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it!

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more...right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode.

Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business.

Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations.

Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends.

Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts.

That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don’t throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works.

You’ll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive.

I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners!

Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion).

Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;-)).

My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done.

There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work.

The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You - Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast-moving, And Positive Company Should. The Contract Details Are As Follows

USD 1,400 a month 25 hrs a week Managed via Upwork

Oh, and hey... if you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don’t believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn’t align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.

The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow... the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle. That’s it, I think.

I’ve probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me ****** with a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version). Thanks for reading this far, Lena

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company - Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer – Part‑Time, Global Running Company

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Hi… My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

You’ll be working on a newsletter and pling! An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it!

  • An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors.

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more ...

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you’ll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don’t throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You’ll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role.

I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;-)). My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you – running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast-moving, and positive company should.

The Contract Details Are As Follows

USD 1,400 a month

25 hrs a week

Managed via Upwork

Oh, and hey… if you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don’t believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn’t align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle.

That’s it, I think. I’ve probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea.

If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via ****** with a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version).

Thanks for reading this far,

Lena

Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3‑4 days as we receive many applicants.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part‑Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Hi…

My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours.

This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours.

Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one!

So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients.

Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B.

I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

You'll be working on a newsletter and pling!

  • An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors.

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it!

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more…right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode.

Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business.

Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations.

Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground.

We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously.

And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You'll also own our digital advertising efforts.

That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle.

We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works.

You will also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations.

If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role.

I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive.

I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners.

Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion).

Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;-)).

My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies.

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way.

We're just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You – Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast‑moving, And Positive Company Should. The Contract Details Are As Follows:

USD 1,400 a month

25 hrs a week

Managed via Upwork

Oh, and hey… if you're considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses.

I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.

The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow–the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That's it, I think.

I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version).

Thanks for reading this far,

Lena

Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3-4 days as we receive many applicants.

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Go! Running Tours by 2x.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

Tether and its affiliated entities (e.g. Bitfinex) are searching for an organized self‑starter to join our Regulatory and Licensing team. The successful candidate is someone with a deep understanding of legal and regulatory requirements pertaining to the crypto‑asset industry in Brazil, and who is excited by the opportunity to apply their existing regulatory experience in an exciting and dynamic business environment.

The successful candidate will report directly to the Head of Regulatory Affairs & Licensing – Latin America, serving as the primary point of contact for regulatory and licensing matters within Brazil. This is a senior position designed for professionals with proven experience engaging with or working within financial regulators, supervisory authorities, or policy‑making bodies. The ideal candidate combines strategic insight with hands‑on execution, demonstrates a diplomatic, solutions‑oriented approach in navigating complex regulatory environments, and is able to anticipate regulatory changes and adapt strategies proactively to evolving market and legal environments. You will represent the company in regulatory discussions, contribute to regional initiatives under the guidance of the Head of Regulatory Affairs & Licensing – Latin America, and ensure local implementation aligns with the company’s broader Latin American regulatory objectives.

To succeed in this role, the incumbent will continuously strive to self‑develop and enhance their skill sets including understanding the Company’s products and services, blockchain technology, crypto‑assets and the regulatory requirements. Engage with industry associations, chambers, and other stakeholder groups to promote innovation and collaboration.

You will have a focus around translating regulatory requirements in Brazil into clear and actionable strategic recommendations, managing relationships and communications between various stakeholders both internal and external to the business.

Responsibilities

Regulatory Strategy Development: development and execution of regulatory strategies, identifying preferable markets in the region from which to operate. Ensure local implementation aligns with Tether’s broader Latin American regulatory objectives.

Regulatory Advocacy and Collaboration: participating in regulatory agency interactions, engaging with relevant regulatory authorities, industry bodies, and policymakers to shape the regulatory landscape for stablecoin issuers, advocating for policies that promote innovation while ensuring safety and compliance. Actively contribute to public consultations, working groups, and industry forums, maintaining a high standard of professionalism and institutional diplomacy.

Policy Analysis and Guidance: Provide analysis on local regulatory proposals, and advise the business on potential regulatory risks and opportunities, while driving initiatives to influence regulatory frameworks as well as monitoring for change across regulations to ensure proactive compliance. Produce concise internal policy briefs and recommendations to inform senior management decision‑making.

Regulatory approval process: contribute to the process of obtaining necessary license approvals in identified markets, where appropriate. Support the preparation and coordination of documentation and responses to regulatory inquiries, ensuring strategic consistency and accuracy.

Cross‑functional Leadership: collaborate with internal teams (e.g., expansion, legal, compliance, finance) to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and to proactively address emerging regulatory challenges. Serve as the local regulatory lead, ensuring effective communication and alignment with regional priorities.

Minimum of 5 years regulatory experience within the financial services or crypto‑asset industry.

Preferred :

Minimum of 5–8 years regulatory experience within financial services, fintech, or crypto‑asset industries.

Ability to apply knowledge of key regulatory frameworks in Brazil both strategically and operationally and provide direction to resolve complex regulatory issues.

Demonstrated diplomatic skills and ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships.

Expertise in preparing regulatory analysis including the preparation and execution of interactions with regulatory authorities, such as regulatory consultation response submissions.

Proven experience working with or within regulatory authorities (e.g., central banks, financial supervisory agencies, or ministries of finance) is strongly preferred.

Demonstrated ability to draft or contribute to public policy responses, regulatory filings, or industry position papers.

Communication :

Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience in public speaking and representing companies in regulatory discussions.

Must be a strong team player, and willing to be fully engaged with key stakeholders both in our company but also with our partners. Must have hands‑on professional capable of working collaboratively and independently, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Fluency in English and native proficiency in the local language of Brazil.

University degree.

Advanced degree in Law, Economics, Political Science, or a related field preferred.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third‑party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page : https : / / tether.recruitee.com /

Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

Double‑check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io.

We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it!

  • Clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world!
  • We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more.

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends.

Email marketing is a strong channel of ours. If you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground.

We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so you’ll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle.

You’ll get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role.

I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive.

I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners!

Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;-)). My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You - Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast-moving, And Positive Company Should.

Contract details are as follows: USD 1,400 a month, 25 hrs a week, managed via Upwork.

Oh, and hey… if you're considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.

The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle.

I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version).

Thanks for reading this far. Lena. Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3‑4 days as we receive many applicants.
