title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer – Part‑time (potential Head of Marketing)

Hi… My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You’ll be working on a newsletter and ... an email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Whoop whoop! Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more… right? I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it. I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don’t throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You'll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do). You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;) ). My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies! We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world. The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You – Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast‑moving, And Positive Company Should. The Contract Details Are As Follows: USD 1,400 a month, 25 hrs a week, managed via Upwork. Oh, and hey… if you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don’t believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn’t align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle. That’s it, I think. I’ve probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me with a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version). Thanks for reading this far, Lena. Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3‑4 days as we receive many applicants.

4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

title: Legal Counsel
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground‑up using best‑in‑class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer‑centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi‑language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Scope

Senior executive officer responsible for the overall management and legal representation of the company in Brazil, ensuring full compliance with applicable laws and regulations, alignment with group strategy, and sound governance, risk and control frameworks. Acts as the company’s legal representative alongside other three directors before public authorities, regulators, financial institutions and key partners.

Key Responsibilities
  • Corporate management: lead the implementation of the business plan in Brazil, follow HQ priorities and ensure operational and financial targets are met.
  • Legal representation: act as the company’s legal representative before the Central Bank of Brazil and other regulators, tax authorities, courts, financial institutions, partners and suppliers, signing contracts, powers of attorney and corporate documents.
  • Regulatory relationship: maintain a constructive and transparent relationship with Brazilian regulators and self‑regulatory bodies, including responding to inspections, official inquiries and information requests.
  • Financial stewardship: approve budgets according to HQ instructions, monitor cash flow, capital and liquidity needs, and ensure timely and accurate financial reporting according to the finance team and regulatory reporting.
  • People and culture: build and lead the local leadership team, promote an ethical culture, and ensure adherence to the company’s code of conduct and policies, acting in a horizontal relationship alongside officers responsible for AML/CFT, Internal Controls & Compliance, and Risk, Capital & Disclosure.
Requirements
  • 5+ years of professional experience, with solid background in financial services, payments, fintech and/or crypto, including prior experience in leadership or management roles;
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian regulatory landscape applicable to the business (Central Bank of Brazil, COAF and, where relevant, CVM and other authorities).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business Administration, Economics, Accounting, Finance, Engineering or a related field; an MBA or similar is a plus.
  • Proven leadership, stakeholder‑management and decision‑making skills, with a hands‑on, ownership mindset.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must be resident in Brazil.
Legal Constraints
  • I — not to be barred by special law, nor convicted of bankruptcy crimes, tax evasion, malfeasance, active or passive bribery, extortion, embezzlement, crimes against the popular economy, public faith, property, or the National Financial System, nor sentenced to a penalty that prohibits, even temporarily, access to public office;
  • II — not to have been declared disqualified or suspended from serving in statutory or contractual bodies at institutions authorized to operate by the Central Bank of Brazil or at pension entities, insurance companies, capitalization companies, publicly held companies, or entities subject to the supervision of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Brazil (CVM);
  • III — not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • V — knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • VI — technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer – Part‑Time (Grow Into Head of Marketing)

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours

Hi… My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let’s start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients.

Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

You’ll be working on a newsletter and pling! An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. It’s not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more…right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You'll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do). You will be working directly with me in the role.

I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that “makes sense” to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;-)). My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You – Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast-moving, And Positive Company Should. The Contract Details Are As Follows: USD 1,400 a month, 25 hrs a week, Managed via Upwork. Oh, and hey… if you're considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That’s it, I think. I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version ). Thanks for reading this far, Lena

title: Groepsbegeleider Justitiële jongeren
description:
Daadkrachtig, empathisch en hoopvol

Bij de Kleinschalige Voorziening Justitiële Jongeren (KVJJ) in Krimpen aan den IJssel werk je met jongeren voor wie stabiliteit, vertrouwen en perspectief het verschil maken. Jij biedt dat verschil met jouw professionele inzet, levenservaring en warme aanwezigheid.

Jouw rol

Als sociaal werker bij Timon verbind je je met jongeren en gezinnen in kwetsbare omstandigheden. Je werkt samen aan herstel, groei en het verkleinen van de kans op (terugval in) crimineel gedrag.

Geen dag is hetzelfde: de ene keer voer je een verdiepend gesprek met een jongere, de andere keer begeleid je een dagstructuur of werk je samen met ouders, school of netwerkpartners. Jij bent de stabiele factor die jongeren helpt richting te vinden.

In de KVJJ verblijven maximaal acht justitiële jongeren die tijdens hun voorlopige hechtenis of het laatste deel van hun straf of PIJ-maatregel dichtbij hun netwerk, school en ouders geplaatst worden. De focus ligt op continuïteit van zorg, onderwijs en het versterken van het eigen netwerk. Overdag gaan jongeren naar school of werk; jij ondersteunt en stimuleert hen hierin.

Wat je gaat doen
  • Begeleiden van jongeren in hun dagelijkse structuur en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.
  • Werken vanuit herstelgericht en systeemgericht denken: je betrekt ouders en netwerk actief.
  • Signaleren van risico’s en kansen in het gedrag en de omgeving van jongeren.
  • Samenwerken met DJI, collega’s, onderwijsinstellingen en hulpverleners.
  • Werken in verschillende diensten (dag, avond en weekend) binnen een stabiel team.
Jij brengt mee
  • Een afgeronde MBO-4 opleiding Sociaal Werker (of vergelijkbaar niveau).
  • Ervaring in het werken met jongeren in complexe of justitiële context is een pre.
  • Een stabiele, zelfbewuste persoonlijkheid die grenzen stelt én nabijheid biedt.
  • Vermogen om een veilige en voorspelbare sfeer te scheppen op de groep.
  • Bereidheid om in onregelmatige diensten te werken.
Daarom kies je voor Timon
  • Bij Timon krijg je ruimte om te groeien professioneel én persoonlijk. We bieden je:
  • en uitdagende en betekenisvolle functie in een betrokken en gemotiveerd team.
  • Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor 32-36 uur per week, met uitzicht op verlenging.
  • Salaris volgens de cao Jeugdzorg, schaal 6 of 7 (afhankelijk van ervaring).
  • Onregelmatigheidstoeslag, reiskostenvergoeding en pensioenregeling.
  • Professionele begeleiding, ontwikkelmogelijkheden en aandacht voor jouw welzijn.
Wij zijn Timon

Je christelijke geloof verbinden met je professionele inzet? Dat kan bij Timon! Bij ons ben je er voor kinderen, jongeren en ouders. En ons team is er voor jóu. Iedereen kan een beroep op ons doen, ongeacht achtergrond en levensovertuiging. Met ruim 750 bevlogen medewerkers werken we in een groot deel van Nederland. Timon innoveert en groeit. We denken in kansen en zetten graag een stapje extra.

Binnen Timon zijn er volop mogelijkheden om je verder te specialiseren. Bijvoorbeeld binnen een van de zorgconcepten die we bieden. Zoals Ouderschap na Scheiding, Kinderen uit de Knel, intensieve ambulante gezinsbegeleiding (IAG) en Ambulante spoedhulp.

Jij @ Timon?

Herken je jezelf in deze vacature en denk jij dat Timon de organisatie is die bij je past? Dan zien we je sollicitatie graag tegemoet.

Wil je een dag meelopen om kennis te maken met het team en de werkzaamheden, dan is dat mogelijk. Wil je graag meer informatie of heb je eerst nog wat vragen? Dat kan! Je kunt contact opnemen met onze recruiter.

Voor indiensttreding is het screeningsbeleid van Timon van toepassing. Deze is altijd opvraagbaar en wordt toegelicht in het arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part‑Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part‑Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours .

Hi, My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients.

Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

You’ll be working on a newsletter and plan email flows. For example, an email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time – not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more.

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business, testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations, and taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you’ll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts – planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don’t throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You’ll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that “makes sense” to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness). My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You – Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast‑moving, And Positive Company Should. The Contract Details Are As Follows

  • USD 1,400 a month
  • 25 hrs a week
  • Managed via Upwork

Oh, and hey… if you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don’t believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn’t align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle. That’s it, I think.

I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version).

Thanks for reading this far,

Lena

Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3‑4 days as we receive many applicants.

Sobre nós

A XP Educação :

Na XPE, acreditamos que a educação é a força mais poderosa para transformar vidas. Assim como a XP mirou o impossível e revolucionou o mercado financeiro, estamos redefinindo o jeito de ensinar e aprender no Brasil.

Fomos pioneiros ao lançar o primeiro MBA em Inteligência Artificial para Negócios do país, antecipando as demandas do mercado e formando líderes preparados para o futuro. E mais : nossa Faculdade possui nota máxima no MEC — um reconhecimento conquistado por apenas 3% das instituições de ensino superior no Brasil.

Oferecemos uma formação prática, centrada no “saber fazer”, com muita mão na massa e conexão direta com o mercado. Nosso compromisso é com uma educação inovadora, disruptiva e centrada no aluno — feita para quem quer começar, acelerar ou transformar sua carreira em tecnologia e negócios.

Como marca empregadora referência no Brasil, também fomos os primeiros a certificar 100% dos nossos colaboradores em Inteligência Artificial, provando que a transformação começa de dentro para fora. E agora, abrimos todo esse know-how em negócios, tecnologia e mercado financeiro para formar os profissionais que o futuro exige.

Impulsionamos o lifelong learning com um modelo de ensino não linear, flexível e de alta qualidade, sempre aliado a serviços de carreira que aproximam nossos alunos das melhores oportunidades no mercado.

Se você busca entender o mundo da tecnologia e dos negócios para crescer de forma exponencial — seja bem-vindo à XP Educação.

Sobre a oportunidade

Como Technical Product Manager, você será responsável por conectar negócio e tecnologia para transformar desafios em soluções digitais escaláveis e de alto impacto. Atuará na definição de prioridades, organização do roadmap e condução de processos de discovery, garantindo entregas que impulsionem a experiência do usuário e os resultados da empresa.

Somos uma empresa em construção, então aqui o aprendizado é constante e você terá pista livre para criar e muitos (muitos mesmo!) desafios. Além disso, você trabalhará ao lado de pessoas diversas e talentosas que irão te ajudar a usar todo o seu potencial e gerar o maior impacto possível.

Alguns dos desafios que você vai encontrar:
  • Descoberta e definição de produto: conduzir entrevistas, mapeamento de processos e levantamentos com stakeholders para entender necessidades e traduzi-las em soluções de produto.
  • Priorização e roadmap: organizar backlog, avaliar trade‑offs e definir prioridades de forma estratégica, sempre orientado por impacto no negócio e experiência do usuário.
  • Colaboração com engenharia: atuar lado a lado com o time técnico, garantindo clareza nas especificações, alinhamento em arquitetura de soluções e acompanhamento próximo da execução.
  • Gestão de stakeholders: comunicar de forma clara e estruturada com áreas acadêmicas, operações, marketing e diretoria, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos e vice‑versa.
  • Metodologias ágeis: aplicar boas práticas de Scrum / Kanban / Lean, conduzindo rituais e garantindo cadência de entregas.
  • Mentalidade Product‑led: criar soluções que sejam centradas em produto, priorizando escalabilidade, experiência do usuário e impacto de longo prazo.
  • Gestão de riscos e problemas: antecipar obstáculos, propor soluções e manter resiliência no desenvolvimento de novos fluxos.
Sobre o ambiente de trabalho, é importante você saber que:

Aqui na XP Educação, cultivamos uma cultura de mente aberta, onde a horizontalidade é real e as decisões são tomadas com base em fatos e dados — sempre com os interesses dos nossos clientes em primeiro lugar.

Valorizamos o espírito empreendedor. Por isso, cada pessoa é protagonista da própria trajetória. Não espere que as decisões venham de cima: aqui, você tem autonomia para construir seu caminho, assumir responsabilidades e fazer acontecer.

Sabemos que grandes sonhos exigem esforço. Por isso, nossa rotina é intensa — e isso nos move. Amamos o que fazemos e acreditamos que só assim conseguimos transformar realidades por meio da educação.

title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
Career CategoryMedical AffairsJob Description

JUNTE-SE À MISSÃO DA AMGEN DE SERVIR AOS PACIENTES Na Amgen, se você sente que faz parte de algo maior, é porque realmente faz.

Nossa missão compartilhada — servir aos pacientes que vivem com doenças graves — impulsiona tudo o que fazemos.Desde

  • temos sido pioneiros no mundo da biotecnologia em nossa luta contra as doenças mais difíceis do mundo.

Com nosso foco em quatro áreas terapêuticas — Oncologia, Inflamação, Medicina Geral e Doenças Raras — alcançamos milhões de pacientes a cada ano.

Como membro da equipe Amgen, você ajudará a causar um impacto duradouro na vida dos pacientes enquanto pesquisamos, fabricamos e entregamos medicamentos inovadores para ajudar as pessoas a viverem vidas mais longas, plenas e felizes.

Nosso cultura premiada é colaborativa, inovadora e baseada na ciência.

Se você tem paixão por desafios e pelas oportunidades que eles oferecem, você prosperará como parte da equipe Amgen.

Junte-se a nós e transforme a vida dos pacientes enquanto transforma sua carreira.

Medical Science Liaison

O Medical Science Liaison é um profissional altamente qualificado da indústria farmacêutica, responsável por estabelecer uma relação científica com médicos e especialistas da área.

Atua como um ponto de contato entre a Amgen e os profissionais de saúde, com foco em oferecer informações científicas detalhadas, dados clínicos, apoio para a utilização adequada de medicamentos e coleta de insights importantes para a estratégia médica da área terapêutica.

Sede da vaga : São Paulo.

É necessário ter disponibilidade para viagens (60%).

80% da atuação nesta vaga será em campo.

Responsabilidades principais

Construir e Manter Relacionamentos Científicos: Estabelecer uma rede de contatos com líderes de opinião chave (KOLs) e outros profissionais de saúde para discutir dados clínicos e avanços terapêuticos.

Educação Científica: Fornecer apresentações científicas detalhadas sobre a doença e os produtos e pesquisas atuais para médicos, profissionais da saúde, hospitais e grupos de saúde.

Suporte Clínico: fornecer feedback de especialistas da área sobre os produtos.

Apoio às Equipes Internas: Trabalhar de perto com equipes de marketing, vendas e acesso para garantir a precisão das informações científicas e apoiar no desenvolvimento de estratégias.

Desenvolver e Realizar Treinamentos: Realizar sessões de treinamento interno e externos para garantir que as partes interessadas compreendam os aspectos científicos dos produtos e áreas terapêuticas.

Avaliar e Coletar Feedback Clínicos e de Mercado: Identificar tendências no tratamento de doenças e novas necessidades no mercado, proporcionando insights valiosos para a estratégia da empresa.

O que esperamos de você

Somos todos diferentes, mas usamos nossas contribuições únicas para servir aos pacientes.

O profissional qualificado que buscamos é um Medical Science Liaison, com as seguintes qualificações:

Qualificações Básicas

Doutorado OU Mestrado + 3 anos de experiência em Assuntos Médicos OU Bacharelado + 5 anos de experiência em Assuntos Médicos.

Qualificações Desejáveis

Formação acadêmica: Graduação completa em área relacionada à saúde (Medicina, Farmácia, Biomedicina, Enfermagem, etc).

Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência como Medical Science Liaison (MSL) ou em posição similar na área de Assuntos Médicos.

Inglês avançado — essencial, espanhol — desejável.

Experiência ou conhecimento na área de Neurologia ou Doenças Raras será altamente valorizado.

Excelente comunicação científica.

Capacidade de construir relacionamento com líderes de opinião médica (KOLs).

Pensamento estratégico, perfil colaborativo e proativo.

O que você pode esperar de nós

Enquanto trabalhamos para desenvolver tratamentos que cuidam dos outros, também cuidamos do crescimento profissional e bem-estar pessoal de nossos colegas.

Além do salário base, a Amgen oferece pacotes de compensação competitivos e abrangentes, alinhados aos padrões da indústria local.

Como uma organização dedicada a melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas ao redor do mundo, a Amgen promove um ambiente inclusivo, com pessoas diversas, éticas, comprometidas e altamente qualificadas, que se respeitam mutuamente e vivem os valores da Amgen para continuar avançando na ciência a serviço dos pacientes.

Juntos, competimos na luta contra doenças graves.

A Amgen não discrimina em suas oportunidades de emprego com base em sexo, raça, cor, idade, nacionalidade, idéias políticas ou religiosas, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nível e tipo deficiência, origem étnica ou qualquer outra categoria protegida por lei.

E fazemos um convite especial às pessoas que se autodeclaram pretas e pardas, LGBTQIAP+, possuem algum tipo de deficiência, tenham +50 anos e mulheres que buscam por posições de liderança, para que conheçam mais sobre a Amgen e nossas oportunidades de carreira, pois temos como compromisso gerar oportunidades para grupos minorizados e criar um ambiente cada vez mais diverso e inclusivo.

Garantiremos que pessoas com deficiência recebam acomodações razoáveis para participar do processo de candidatura ou entrevista, para desempenhar funções essenciais do cargo e para receber outros benefícios e privilégios de emprego.

description:
Soy & Soybean Meal. Global Flows. Real Commercial Impact.

Already plugged into Brazil’s Soy/SBM flows? Bring your experience, relationships, and timing – and help strengthen CM’s footprint in one of the world’s most essential export hubs.

Why This Role Exists

We’re not hiring because we need “someone.”
We’re hiring because if we find the right experienced commercial broker, we will gladly make room … also because the market has more room, more flow, and more opportunity than the team can cover today.

Copenhagen Merchants has been growing in Brazil since opening our São Paulo office in 2022 – today home to four brokers, an execution specialist and an analyst. And we want to take the next step within Soy/SBM, strengthening our global origination–destination network stretching from South America to the Black Sea, EU, MENA, and Asia.

This is a role for someone who can walk in and start creating traction from day one – commercially, relationally, and structurally.

What You’ll Be Doing

You already know what real brokerage looks like – but here’s how it plays out with us:

  • Drive Soy/SBM brokerage across Brazil, South America, and global demand regions
  • Close deals and create value through timing, insight, and relationships
  • Connect daily with charterers, traders, crushers, and distributors – both local and global
  • Leverage CM’s global network (Geneva, Hamburg, Copenhagen, Barcelona, Dubai, Kaunas, etc.)
  • Share updates, pricing, and intel that feed directly into our unique market intelligence platform CM Navigator
  • Work hand-in-hand with local execution and the broader CM freight desks
  • Spot opportunities between origins, flows, and arbitrage – and act fast
  • Be part of a team that aims high but stays collaborative and human

This is senior-level brokerage: desk ownership, accountability, and impact.

Why CM

Before we talk culture, here’s the simple truth: CM gives you more levers to pull than almost any pure brokerage house out there.

At CM, you step into a value chain you won’t find in many brokerage houses:
brokers, freight, terminals, logistics, and digital market intelligence - all connected in one commercial ecosystem.

In São Paulo, you’ll join a small, skilled, and tight-knit team working close to both the market and the decisions. We move fast, keep things flat, and operate with integrity. No micromanagement. No politics. Just strong people doing good business together.

Who You Are

You’re an experienced broker or trader with deep roots in Soy/SBM – ideally across both origination and export flows. Not theoretical knowledge. Real relationships, real deal-history, real intuition.

We imagine you bring:

  • Strong experience in Soy/SBM brokerage or trading
  • A live network of counterparties across the Brazilian and Argentinian market – and beyond
  • A steady hand in volatile markets
  • The ability to operate independently while staying connected to a team
  • Solid commercial instincts + the discipline to follow through
  • Fluency in English; Portuguese required; Spanish a plus
  • A personality that fits our culture: curious, direct, collaborative, human

Above all, you know that brokerage is about trust, timing, and being the one people call first.

What We Offer
  • A role without artificial limits – if you can grow business, we’ll grow with you
  • A highly international setup with deep reach into all major grain flows
  • A nice and centrally located São Paulo office with strong colleagues, low hierarchy, and fast decisions
  • Access to CM Navigator and a global intelligence ecosystem
  • A family-owned group with a long-term mindset and a culture that values people as much as performance>
  • Freedom with accountability – and support when you need it

We don’t micromanage. We don’t do politics. We do markets, relationships, timing – and results.

Interested?

If this feels like the right team and the right platform for your next chapter, we’d love to hear from you – even if your CV isn’t polished.

Apply by uploading your CV, record a short video (max. 60 seconds) if you dare or simply reach out directly for a confidential conversation.

Augusto Abati – Hub lead for CM São Paulo or Simon Bach – Organization & People.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let’s start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that - if you are a runner and marketeer - probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

You’ll be working on a newsletter and pling! an email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed ) and in the future, with your help, many more…right?

  • an email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors.

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it. I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you’ll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don’t throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You’ll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do). You will be working directly with me in the role.

I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;-)). My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies! We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You - Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast-moving, And Positive Company Should.The Contract Details Are As Follows USD 1,400 a month 25 hrs a week Managed via Upwork Oh, and hey... if you’re considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses . I don’t believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn’t align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow... the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle. That’s it, I think.

I’ve probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me ****** w ith a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version ). Thanks for reading this far, Lena. Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3-4 days as we receive many applicants.

description:
We're looking for a hardworking and passionate Software Engineer Manager to join Wildlife's Engineering team.

We know that the work we do has a high impact on our company's success and culture. The right person for this position is curious by nature, and comfortable in a “take the initiative” environment, loves solving problems, and can thrive in a fast and growing business.

The Platform Team at Wildlife is reinventing itself. It started providing services for the games online features and has since evolved to provide a platform that leverages the best of our teams when creating, operating, and distributing our games.

We know that the work we do has a high impact on our company's success, and to achieve that, we work with a broad technology stack and have an approach of being fully responsible for our systems, from their conception to incident resolution and troubleshooting in production.

We own several services that, combined, serve more than 1 million requests per minute. We know this number will only grow, and we're looking for managers who can help with the challenges of developing systems that perform well at a large scale.

What you’ll do
  • Participate in the architecture design of systems, focusing on your customer, whether they are players or other Wildlife employees;
  • Oversee two engineering teams, responsible for delivering features critical to all company games;
  • Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of scalable infrastructure components and tools, ensuring performance, reliability, and cost efficiency;
  • Collaborate closely with leaders across engineering, product, and design to align priorities, balance trade-offs, and remove roadblocks;
  • Collaborate across diverse teams and disciplines to speed up game development, streamline operations, and uncover new avenues for feature expansion and value generation.
What you'll need
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent tech areas and/or equivalent experience;
  • Solid experience in software development and solution design;
  • Solid understanding of computer concepts (data structures, networking, concurrency, memory management, and algorithm analysis);
  • Proven ability to manage engineering teams, develop infrastructure budget estimates, and translate company strategies into tangible, actionable projects.
Nice to have
  • Experience developing and maintaining systems with a high volume of requests;
  • Experience developing systems in the games industry;
  • Business knowledge about the games industry;
  • Experience in Golang;
  • Experience in network sockets;
  • Experience in Unity development.
More about you
  • You're passionate about software development and know how to ensure its quality.
  • You're motivated by building up back-end services and SDKs, aware of their different architectures.
  • Experienced working in an environment that uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You're creative when solving problems and are continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions.
  • You can communicate clearly with your team, other teams, and the company to identify issues and demands.
  • You know when and how to manage up, explaining what you need to achieve your goals.
About Wildlife

Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Today, we have offices in Brazil, Finland and the United States. Here, we create games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!

Coordenador(a) de Segurança da Informação | Application Security (AppSec)

Join to apply for the Coordenador(a) de Segurança da Informação | Application Security (AppSec) role at XP Inc.

Sobre nós

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Sobre a Oportunidade

A área de Application Security da XP Inc. é responsável por garantir que todas as aplicações e produtos digitais da companhia sejam desenvolvidos e operados com os mais altos padrões de segurança, desde a concepção até a produção. O time tem como missão incorporar práticas robustas de segurança em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de software (SDLC), protegendo dados, prevenindo vulnerabilidades e assegurando conformidade com requisitos regulatórios e de negócio.

Essa posição é estratégica, pois atua diretamente na proteção de produtos críticos como Core Banking, PIX e Open Finance. É uma frente essencial para sustentar a confiança dos clientes, preservar a reputação da marca e viabilizar a inovação segura em um ambiente altamente regulado.

Saiba mais sobre nosso dia a dia no Instagram e no LinkedIn.

Confira nossas avaliações no Glassdoor.

O Que Procuramos Pré-requisitos Essenciais
  • Conhecimento avançado em Segurança no Ciclo de Desenvolvimento de Software (SDLC);
  • Experiência sólida na implementação de práticas seguras em pipelines CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Modelagem de Ameaças (Threat Modeling): capacidade de identificar e mitigar riscos desde a fase de design;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Arquitetura Segura de Software: definição de requisitos arquiteturais para autenticação, criptografia, segurança mobile e integrações críticas;
  • Experiência com SAST, DAST, SCA, Secret Scanning, Secret Vault;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Pentesting e Avaliação de Vulnerabilidades: condução e supervisão de testes de segurança.
  • Conhecimento intermediário e/ou experiência em gestão de Indicadores de Segurança: definição, acompanhamento e análise de métricas para tomada de decisão;
  • Liderança inspiradora para engajar times multidisciplinares e comunidades técnicas (ex.: Security Champions);
  • Capacidade de traduzir conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos;
  • Visão estratégica aliada à habilidade de execução prática;
  • Comunicação clara e assertiva com stakeholders de tecnologia e negócio;
  • Resiliência para lidar com prazos agressivos e demandas simultâneas.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência prévia no setor financeiro ou bancário;
  • Certificações como CISSP, CSSLP, OSCP, CEH ou CISM;
  • Vivência com Open Finance, PIX e Core Banking;
  • Experiência na implantação e gestão de programas de Security Champions.
Desafios e Impacto
  • Liderar a frente de Arquitetura de Application Security, gerenciando diretamente o time de analistas, conduzindo atividades inerentes à função, incluindo processo de Avaliação 360 da XP Inc., feedbacks estruturados e reuniões 1:1;
  • Gerir iniciativas, projetos, indicadores e orçamento (people e non-people) da coordenação, com reporte direto ao gerente da área;
  • Produzir e conduzir apresentações executivas para pares, CISO e comitês relacionados, comunicando evolução, resultados e próximos passos da área;
  • Atuar como facilitador na interação com times de DevOps, Arquitetura, 2ª e 3ª Linha de Defesa, além de auditorias externas;
  • Evoluir e escalar o Programa de Desenvolvimento Seguro, garantindo aderência em todas as frentes de tecnologia;
  • Fortalecer a Arquitetura Segura para novas soluções e tecnologias já presentes na stack XP;
  • Integrar e otimizar ferramentas de segurança no pipeline de desenvolvimento, garantindo cobertura e eficiência;
  • Ampliar o impacto e engajamento do Programa Security Champions, mantendo mais de 150 desenvolvedores ativos e capacitados;
  • Garantir que requisitos de segurança sejam incorporados desde a concepção de produtos críticos (Core Banking, PIX, Open Finance);
  • Monitorar e melhorar continuamente mais de 20 indicadores chave de segurança da área de AppSec.
Etapas do Processo
  • Triagem inicial: Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.
  • Testes gerais: Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

  • Entrevista com a liderança: Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.
  • Entrevista com colegas de trabalho: Interação com futuros pares para avaliar a sinergia e o trabalho em equipe.
  • Entrevista focada em cultura: Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.
  • Oferta: Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

description:
Overview

Vaga para nosso BANCO DE TALENTOS

Somos uma empresa do grupo XP com foco em Consultoria Estratégica e Gestão, M&A e Incentivos Fiscais e, hoje, atuamos com mais de 200 empresas, dos mais variados setores. A Galapos está crescendo e buscando talentos em diversas áreas, como finanças, ciências contábeis, economia, administração, negócios, tecnologia, gestão de projetos e engenharias das mais diversas competências.

Seja assessorando em transações de M&A (fusões e aquisições) , seja ajudando empresários a entender o valor de suas empresas, ou conduzindo projetos de melhorias de resultados financeiros e operacionais, ou viabilizando projetos de inovação através de captação e incentivos fiscais - o que nos move é gerar valor.

Temos paixão por entregar mais e melhor porque acreditamos que, impactando positivamente as pessoas com quem trabalhamos e as empresas que são nossas clientes, seremos capazes de ampliar nossa geração de valor para a sociedade.

Nossa cultura é baseada em pessoas e acreditamos que nosso time é nosso maior ativo. Por isso, valorizamos e reconhecemos nossas pessoas em nosso processo de evolução contínua.

Projetos de Inovação

Somos especialistas em incentivos. Temos profissionais multidisciplinares com mais de 10 anos de experiência na gestão de incentivos de fomento à inovação Tecnológica e à P&D.

A gestão integrada de incentivos resulta na otimização do tempo destinado para preparação, controle, fruição e prestação de contas dos benefícios governamentais.

  • Descrever projetos relacionados à pesquisa, desenvolvimento e inovação (PD&I), sugerindo melhorias nos descritivos de projetos e orientando decisões junto ao cliente;
  • Aplicar conhecimentos e metodologias alinhadas com as melhores práticas nacionais e internacionais para realizar a classificação e o enquadramento de projetos nos diferentes tipos de incentivos fiscais e financeiros;
  • Conduzir reuniões técnicas, orientar e acompanhar o cliente em processos de fiscalização dos órgãos governamentais,
  • Preencher as informações qualitativas dos formulários e relatórios de prestação de contas ao Governo, acompanhar necessidades de remanejamento, discutindo com clientes alterações de escopo necessárias;
  • Apoiar trabalhos de Lei de Informática, no que tange aspectos qualitativos, responsabilizar-se por pedidos de habilitação de produtos, inclusão de modelos e pleitos de reconhecimento de tecnologia desenvolvida no País.

Buscamos para nossa equipe de Projetos de Inovação pessoas que tenham aptidão e experiência técnica em:

  • gestão de projetos
  • aptidão para escrita de projetos técnicos
  • conhecimento sobre inovação

Quando falamos de soft skills, buscamos pessoas que:

  • colaborem e tenham empatia
  • inovação e adaptabilidade
  • foco no cliente

title: Lead ML Engineer, Recommendation Systems
description:
Overview

As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology.

Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

We convert audience attention into action through data, machine learning, and continuous optimization.

We’re hiring a Machine Learning Engineer (Recommendation Systems) to build the personalization engine behind our portfolio of brands. You’ll design, deploy, and scale ML systems that power real-time recommendations across millions of user journeys. This role gives you the chance to work on systems serving 100M+ predictions daily, directly impacting engagement, retention, and revenue at scale.

MUST HAVE

You’ve shipped large-scale ML systems into production that power personalization at scale. You’re fluent in ranking algorithms and know how to turn data into engagement and conversions. Specifically:

  • 7+ years building and scaling production ML systems with measurable business impact
  • Strong background in ranking algorithms (collaborative filtering, learning-to-rank, deep learning)
  • Proficiency with Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch)
  • Skilled with SQL and modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) plus data lakes
  • Familiarity with distributed computing (Spark, Ray) and LLM/AI Agent frameworks
  • Track record of improving business KPIs via ML-powered personalization
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms and experiment logging best practices
YOUR ROLE

Your mission: Drive business growth by building and optimizing the recommendation systems that personalize experience for millions of users daily. You’ll own the modeling, feature engineering, data pipelines, and experimentation that make personalization smarter, faster, and more impactful.

OUTCOMES
  • Build and deploy ML models serving 100M+ predictions per day to personalize user experiences at scale
  • Enhance data processing pipelines (Spark, Beam, Dask) with efficiency and reliability improvements
  • Design ranking algorithms that balance relevance, diversity, and revenue
  • Deliver real-time personalization with latency <50ms across key product surfaces
  • Run statistically rigorous A/B tests to measure true business impact
  • Optimize for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency in production
  • Partner with product, engineering, and analytics to launch high-impact personalization features
  • Implement monitoring systems and maintain clear ownership for model reliability
COMPETENCIES
  • Technical Mastery: You know ML architecture, deployment, and tradeoffs inside out
  • Experimentation Infrastructure: You set up systems for rapid testing and retraining (MLflow, W&B)
  • Impact-Driven: You design models that move revenue, retention, or engagement
  • Collaborative: You thrive working with engineers, PMs, and analysts to scope features
  • Analytical Thinking: You break down data trends and design rigorous test methodologies
  • Ownership Mentality: You own your models post-deployment and continuously improve them
  • Execution-Oriented: You deliver production-grade systems quickly without sacrificing rigor
  • Curious & Innovative: You stay on top of ML advances and apply them to personalization

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

EXPERIENCE: 10+ years designing, developing, and deploying large-scale machine learning systems with a focus on personalization

  • Champion privacy-preserving personalization, responsible AI practices, and adaptive learning systems

COMPETENCIES

  • Visionary Thinking: Defines the future state of ML infrastructure and personalization strategy. Balances deep technical rigor with a strong understanding of product impact.
  • Architectural Excellence: Designs scalable, modular systems that support billions of predictions and enable rapid experimentation. Sets high standards for maintainability and performance.
  • Technical Influence: Drives decision-making and builds consensus across teams and stakeholders without direct authority. Provides trusted guidance in ambiguous situations.

  • Curious & Forward-Looking: Constantly explores new approaches to personalization and actively prototypes cutting-edge methodologies.

title: Gerente de Business Analytics
description:
Descrição da vaga

Minerva Foods é líder na exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a empresa está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália. Com suas 46 unidades industriais, oferece produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, comercializados para clientes em todo o mundo por meio de 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

A área de Business Analytics tem como propósito resolver problemas de negócio utilizando dados, algoritmos e técnicas estatísticas aplicadas a finalidades específicas. As principais áreas de aplicação são: logística, comercial, operação industrial (Indústria 4.0), pricing e otimização de produção.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Manter contato constante com as áreas de negócio para identificar oportunidades de melhoria de processos ou geração de informações estratégicas por meio de modelos preditivos, técnicas de machine learning, otimização e pesquisa operacional.
  • Gerenciar o time responsável por traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções analíticas, garantindo clareza para o time técnico durante a implantação.
  • Conduzir reuniões com desenvoltura, compreendendo as necessidades das áreas e transformando-as em oportunidades de projeto.
  • Validar e avaliar soluções analíticas, de ciência de dados e pesquisa operacional, direcionando as melhores alternativas para cada desafio.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de gerenciamento de projetos, analisando cronogramas, identificando pontos críticos e reconhecendo todos os stakeholders envolvidos.
  • Ter conhecimento em change management para aplicação em diversos projetos da área.
  • Elaborar documentação de projetos e documentação funcional das soluções, atuando como interface com as áreas clientes e garantindo a cadência das entregas — com início, meio e fim bem definidos.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Pós-graduação, mestrado ou doutorado serão considerados diferenciais.
  • Conhecimento imprescindível em técnicas de modelagem estatística, machine learning e/ou pesquisa operacional.
  • Experiência mínima de 7 anos em Business Analytics / Analytics.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos como gestor de equipe.
  • Conhecimento lógico e técnico em SQL e Python.
Desejável
  • Inglês em nível avançado.
  • Espanhol em nível intermediário.
Diferencial
  • Experiência prévia como gestor ou líder de equipes em áreas analíticas.
Informações adicionais
  • Local de trabalho: Híbrido (4 dias presenciais).
  • Carga horária: 44 horas semanais.
  • Cidades: São Paulo ou Campinas.
  • País: Brasil.

Bem-vindo à Minerva Foods! Lider na exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul, a Minerva Foods é mais do que uma empresa global – somos uma comunidade de profissionais com o propósito de seguir "criando conexões entre pessoas, alimentos e natureza". Atuamos em mais de 100 países, e contamos com unidades no Brasil, Paraguai, Argentina, Uruguai, Colômbia e plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália e no Chile.

Com uma gestão sólida e estratégias inovadoras, buscamos constantemente os mercados mais promissores, modernizando nossas operações e oferecendo produtos de alta qualidade. Nossa logística integrada e diversificação geográfica garantem soluções que atendem às mais rigorosas demandas globais.

Na Minerva Foods, sustentabilidade não é apenas um compromisso – é parte do nosso DNA. Adotamos práticas responsáveis que promovem a preservação ambiental, o bem-estar animal e a transparência em toda a cadeia de produção. Com iniciativas robustas de rastreabilidade, contribuímos para um futuro mais sustentável e transparente.

Nosso impacto global é sustentado por 46 unidades industriais, 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais. Esses pilares nos permitem entregar produtos saudáveis e nutritivos para clientes em todo o mundo.

Se você compartilha valores como Orientação para Resultados, Comprometimento, Sustentabilidade, Inovação e Reconhecimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time. Aqui, você encontrará um ambiente que incentiva a excelência, promove o desenvolvimento e cria impacto positivo para as gerações futuras.

O banhista tem papel fundamental no cuidado e bem-estar dos pets, garantindo não apenas a higiene, mas também um atendimento acolhedor e de qualidade. Suas atividades envolvem:

  • Avaliação inicial do pet : observar temperamento, porte, condições da pelagem e da pele, verificando possíveis nós, presença de parasitas ou necessidades específicas de cuidado.
  • Banho : preparar o animal, utilizar produtos adequados para cada tipo de pelagem, realizar o banho de forma segura, zelando pelo conforto do pet e minimizando situações de estresse.
  • Cuidados complementares : secagem com soprador e/ou toalhas, escovação adequada, desembolo de pelos, hidratações, além da tosa higiênica em regiões específicas para manutenção da saúde e higiene.
  • Finalização : uso de perfumes e acessórios quando aplicável, garantindo que o pet saia limpo, cheiroso e bem-apresentado.
  • Organização do ambiente : manter a limpeza e higienização do espaço de banho e tosa, organizar utensílios, zelar pela segurança dos equipamentos e pela manutenção do ambiente adequado aos animais.
  • Gestão de agenda : acompanhar horários de atendimento, respeitar os agendamentos e colaborar com a equipe para fluxo organizado de clientes.
  • Relacionamento : lidar com diferentes tipos de animais com paciência e carinho, transmitindo segurança; além de manter comunicação atenciosa e respeitosa com os tutores, tirando dúvidas e orientando sobre os cuidados após o banho.

Amor por pets: gostar de cuidar e lidar com diferentes espécies, demonstrando carinho, paciência e responsabilidade.

Prazer, somos a Petz: o melhor ecossistema do segmento pet

A Petz tem como propósito criar valor e proporcionar a melhor experiência possível na relação entre o pet e o seu tutor. E, para que isso seja possível, temos como visão sermos reconhecidos mundialmente, até 2025, como o melhor ecossistema do segmento pet.

Com uma estratégia omnicanal e que integra não só os canais físicos e digitais, mas também os segmentos de produtos e serviços, somos uma plataforma de soluções completa para os animais de estimação.

Nossa proposta é oferecer aos nossos clientes uma experiência de compra e atendimento diferenciado em nossas lojas físicas, além de agilidade e conveniência em nossos canais digitais. Sim, queremos estar presentes em todos os momentos da vida dos nossos clientes, tutores e pets.

Contamos, também, com a maior rede de centros de estética do Brasil e, sob a marca Seres , com a mais abrangente rede de centros veterinários do país; além de, por meio do maior programa nacional de adoção de cães e gatos, o Adote Petz , fomentamos a criação da conexão emocional do tutor com o seu novo melhor amigo.

E ainda nem falamos dos produtos da marca Petz , que já são mais de 300 itens disponíveis em todas as nossas lojas, sendo líder de vendas nas 25 categorias de produtos ofertados. Com um faturamento que cresce mais de 40% ao ano, isso mostra o quanto somos fortes, inovadores e entregamos produtos de qualidade aos nossos clientes.

E, aos poucos, esse ecossistema vem se expandindo e se fortalecendo com a chegada de grandes marcas do segmento junto ao grupo Petz, dentre elas: Zee.Dog , Cansei de Ser Gato, Cão Cidadão e Petix. Legal né?

A estratégia de omnicanalidade nos trouxe até aqui, e assim nos tornamos líderes de mercado e também uma empresa que dobra de tamanho a cada dois anos. Mas somos incansáveis e sabemos que há muito a ser feito, para isso, estamos investindo em fortalecer ainda mais o nosso ecossistema de serviços, produtos e contratação de gente melhor que a gente para continuar alcançando voos ainda mais altos e resultados expressivos.

Se você respondeu sim para todas essas perguntas, então vem fazer parte do #EcossistemaPetz #SomosPetz.

Title: Future Talent - Automation Specialist

Location: Monte Mor, São Paulo, BR

At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available everywhere, and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day.

And we need people like you to make it happen.

We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.

At Tetra Pak, you will have the freedom to use your expertise and deliver world-class services and solutions that make a real difference. As part of our Future Talent Program – Technical Track, an 18-month journey designed to empower you to reach your potential while making an impact, you will be a valued team member with a development plan tailored specifically to your role.

No matter what you do, you play a part in achieving our purpose. We commit to making food safe and available everywhere, and we promise to protect what’s good: food, people, and the planet. As you advance your skills in an environment where you’ll truly feel supported, you’ll gain broad insights into our company, our culture, and our values.

Here, you will have the security you need to focus on what is important, both professionally and personally. The program offers project rotations, international assignments (in person or remotely), hands‑on experience in your department, and formal training from our global network of colleagues. Upon completing the program, you will have built strong relationships, gained invaluable knowledge, and experienced a world of opportunities to help continue your exciting career within our company.

We are looking for recent grads that are highly driven, have an innovative mindset, an aptitude for problem solving, passion in applying theoretical knowledge to real challenges, strong communication skills and are true team players that enjoy working with people from various cultures.

As a Future Talent Automation Specialist, you will begin a hands‑on learning journey focused on implementing and commissioning automation solutions for food and beverage production. You will gain practical experience in system testing, I/O checks, and equipment start‑up at customer sites. With guidance from experienced colleagues, you’ll learn to turn customer needs into reliable automation setups that meet Tetra Pak’s standards, preparing you to support smooth project execution and contribute to protecting food, people, and the planet.

Join us, and make an impact to be proud of.

This position will be based in Monte Mor, SP. You would be required to travel up to 20% of your time during the trainee program, with the expectation of increased travel (up to 50%) after the development phase, for equipment commissioning and installation at customer sites.

The start date for Future Talent Program will be in February 2026.

Suggested majors: University Degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Automation, Systems Engineering, or other related fields.

We strongly encourage applications from individuals belonging to underrepresented or minorized groups, including women, Black, Indigenous, LGBTQ+ people, people with disabilities, and others.

What you will do

As a Future Talent Automation Specialist, you will:

  • Develop and test applications of different systems following internal guidelines and tools for production processes in the food industry, mainly beverages and dairy products;
  • Perform complete I/O checks of electrical panels;
  • Travel to customer sites to complete equipment commissioning;
  • Manage multiple projects as needed;
  • Maintain a professional attitude and working relationship with colleagues and clients.
We believe you have
  • Degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Automation, Systems Engineering, or related fields;
  • Finished or will finish your studies between December 2023 and December 2025;
  • Availability to travel up to 20% of the time during the trainee program, with the expectation of increased travel (up to 50%) after the development phase;
  • Passion for excellence;
  • Customer centricity;
  • Interest in taking your career to the next level;
  • Analytical and communication skills, initiative, team spirit, and willingness to be part of a multicultural company;
  • Intermediate English level (Spanish would be a plus);
  • Quality-focused;
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

We Offer You

  • A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results

Descrição da empresa Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras global de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado, que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos e guiados pelos nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Ajudamos a alimentar e vestir cerca de 500 milhões de pessoas todos os anos, originando, processando e transportando aproximadamente 81 milhões de toneladas de produtos. Estruturada como uma organização matricial de 6 regiões geográficas e 10 plataformas, a LDC está ativa em mais de 100 países e emprega cerca de 18.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Descrição da vaga Responsável por supervisionar os processos produtivos, desde o recebimento da matéria-prima até a entrega do produto final, por meio de vistorias e verificações diárias em cada setor, além da análise de relatórios operacionais, garantindo o cumprimento dos padrões de qualidade, segurança, produtividade e eficiência estabelecidos pela unidade.

Principais responsabilidades
  • Supervisionar as atividades diárias das equipes operacionais, promovendo o alinhamento e a execução das tarefas conforme os procedimentos internos;

  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos e propor ações corretivas/preventivas;
  • Garantir a organização e o bom funcionamento dos setores sob sua responsabilidade.
Qualificações
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em processos industriais e gestão de equipes;
  • Desejável conhecimento prévio no setor de bebidas e/ou alimentos;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em regime de turnos e residir em Matão/SP.
Diversidade, Inclusão e Equidade

A diversidade é parte do nosso DNA. A LDC busca sempre criar um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas possam prosperar. Respeitamos e valorizamos talentos de todos os gêneros, idades, raças, etnias, sexualidades, religiões e deficiências. Diversidade é um de nossos valores! Essa oportunidade destina-se também às pessoas com deficiências (PcD).

Sustentabilidade

O valor sustentável está no centro de nosso propósito como empresa. Somos apaixonados pela criação de valor justo e sustentável, tanto para nossos negócios quanto para outros stakeholders da cadeia de valor: nosso pessoal, nossos parceiros comerciais, as comunidades e o meio ambiente ao nosso redor.
